## Shocking Revelation about Biden's Speech and Democrat's Strategy
### Tuesday, September 6th, 2022
Friend, I don't care if someone is a libertarian, conservative, independent or MAGA Republican. If you share our view that protecting liberty for the next generation is important, we want you in our growing movement. Which is why we were quick to defend the tens of millions of people that Joe Biden labeled a "threat" to democracy. His speech was so disgusting, and so wrong, I couldn't help but dedicate our show to the topic today. We reveal how Biden's speech is complete BS based on the Democrat strategy of making MAGA Republicans victors of their primaries. Plus, we pick apart the speech and dive into how radical Biden and the Democrats have become. **Watch us prove that Biden is full of crap about MAGA Republicans being a threat. **The same Democrat party that just authorized the unprecedented FBI raid of President Trump’s home over “documents” just voted to give the IRS enough of your hard-earned money to hire 87,000 new IRS agents to come after the rest of us.**

name: Herschel Walker
subject: We’ve pulled our ads to save money
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TEAM HERSCHEL, INC
body:
We don’t currently have the money to run TV ads. We’re being outraised and outspent by the Democrats. |
---

Peter - Our ads have gone dark.

**To conserve our limited resources, we had to pull our TV ads off the air.** Meanwhile, Senator Raphael Warnock and far-Left Super PACs are flooding the airways _**EVERY DAY.**_

This is a tremendous challenge with just 63 days left in the campaign.

name: Kristi Noem
subject: Personal Letter for Peter
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Republican National Committee
body:
Dear Peter,

Growing up, my dad told me every single day, “You don’t complain about things, you fix them.”

My dad was the hardest worker that I knew. He led by example and action. After he passed, I made the decision to be like my dad: a person of words and of action, because both matter. That’s why I ran for office. I am committed to always serving the people of South Dakota with both words and action. I will do what I say, and I will always tell you what I’m doing.

We learn important lessons from our fathers. My dad's lessons still resonate with me today. Our Founding Fathers taught us many such lessons. They taught us that freedom is a cause worth fighting for. "Give me liberty or give me death," Patrick Henry famously said. So many of the brave men who followed George Washington into battle died in the pursuit of that same liberty.

[**Help Republicans retake Congress
and save America. ⇒**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=82903fe4601543d9a5192818ff948e65&_e=ps1XyU0PUtq_NX4HLnXlLKGOq3Qv500gccMO4r5w2WK5Apgsas112TZceLSC2uWvHxUmIZooUBAC9400pWrA7h3ymDcoISe8-MzMSw-swnKVpkvEJgybb41YJdIE42NqEfCZsiF9BdbqFcFNtyFfA_TYIq15JQ6ccCGvhyDutOqZKR3vw7w6z7WM7_DjworiwPf2xTTVOBjCe7exvIOs42Ru6LKUji3XjycDtEH_5HKltrRtC2K6xIDGRh7BZHpGdg74lViJA62iBOQvKOS2icgBPohaDBBGwMQmLjETD4NSVIsKV0-WGTiCBPy4KoYcWvgeQ-KplfuVzsHciFECq95PXFvF0e31_LkDP15Ir49mohVczBZsD20BTfoFXGStqoYA-ZVbf9ED2UDtQfzFM81UfqixK6P8RT3KJX2aY2Qw674zmQN7bJjy8GHOcriEITI5bXlo2ed7jNOIwUsJ7w%3D%3D)
It's easy to forget that before America's Founding, liberty wasn't widely recognized. The rights to "life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness" that Thomas Jefferson wrote about were a controversial idea at the time. America was the first nation built around those rights.

The lessons that we learn from our fathers don't become less important just because we grow older. And the ideals laid out by our Founding Fathers are no less true in a 21st Century America. As we see threats to those ideals, to American freedom, we need to fight for them with the same vigor as Patrick Henry and the same resolve as George Washington.

[**Will you help us win back
our Republican majority? ⇒**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=82903fe4601543d9a5192818ff948e65&_e=ps1XyU0PUtq_NX4HLnXlLKGOq3Qv500gccMO4r5w2WK5Apgsas112TZceLSC2uWvHxUmIZooUBAC9400pWrA7h3ymDcoISe8-MzMSw-swnKVpkvEJgybb41YJdIE42NqEfCZsiF9BdbqFcFNtyFfA_TYIq15JQ6ccCGvhyDutOqZKR3vw7w6z7WM7_DjworiwPf2xTTVOBjCe7exvIOs42Ru6LKUji3XjycDtEH_5HKltrRtC2K6xIDGRh7BZHpGdg74lViJA62iBOQvKOS2icgBPohaDBBGwMQmLjETD4NSVIsKV0-WGTiCBPy4KoYcnfxCbLhy3YU716q7OA_iS7844xheP3SMKywe2znrLouc9A5UDlFN5RD2E7SdC4iUja6TIO3s7GygJesdogF01OMFswHESL_uAZuqKMoy3A2Z_0bYy7VhrtuqBLL8ngpsdqmiwIIRK2FDiufwwEgz4w%3D%3D)
We must fight for the future of our nation. Americans have no faith in Joe Biden and the Democrat Party. But we have not lost faith in ourselves. We will defend American values, rights, and freedoms. We will not let President Biden ruin this great country.

We can retake our Republican majority in November, but we need your help. Will you join me in this fight to save our great country?

[**Please contribute ANY AMOUNT RIGHT NOW to help Republicans take back the House and Senate and save America from the Democrats’ destructive agenda. >>**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=82903fe4601543d9a5192818ff948e65&_e=ps1XyU0PUtq_NX4HLnXlLKGOq3Qv500gccMO4r5w2WK5Apgsas112TZceLSC2uWvHxUmIZooUBAC9400pWrA7h3ymDcoISe8-MzMSw-swnKVpkvEJgybb41YJdIE42NqEfCZsiF9BdbqFcFNtyFfA_TYIq15JQ6ccCGvhyDutOqZKR3vw7w6z7WM7_DjworiwPf2xTTVOBjCe7exvIOs42Ru6LKUji3XjycDtEH_5HKltrRtC2K6xIDGRh7BZHpGdg74lViJA62iBOQvKOS2icgBPohaDBBGwMQmLjETD4NSVIsKV0-WGTiCBPy4KoYcdod1aTqJy1PnswWDcsttdCXBpVWa3use7tlvnlwRp6MkwlyHKpBQG7RLeB8UEhodxXIusMLzNHucTT6A632p7j5_X0FSDNiBX2SWgWbtDmc61Th4Yt668CBWWFJ1IXM6v1ZI1vob0TfSnYIQR2G1JQ%3D%3D)

subject: We CANNOT sustain our efforts without you…
body:
| | | Peter, Former President Trump is going on the offensive and appears to be launching a full-scale fight against the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI). We here at the America First Policy Institute are joining the fight. I'm sure you already know the backstory: The FBI recently raided former President Trump's home in what could be politically-motivated. This ordeal should paint a clear picture for us: The deep state is real, and we can't afford to sit around playing defense while the FBI raids a former President's home. **_We MUST go on the offensive._** [**And that 's exactly what I plan to do. Will you help me?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61211765:JcUYpwVN0:m:1:3253819041:30AC21EE60486868EE49DE3916111ED2:r) _Our country is at risk of crumbling into a banana republic run by the most radical leftists in America and an invulnerable deep state. WE HAVE NO CHOICE BUT TO FIGHT BACK!_ When the news broke, our entire team sprung into action to respond. Within 48 hours, we filed more than 50 Freedom of Information Act requests to expose the Biden Administration and find out who knew what and when. But I assure you, the Department of Justice (DOJ) is not going to hand over information easily, and we may have to battle with the DOJ for months or even YEARS to uncover the truth fully. **We CANNOT sustain our efforts without you ... ** **[Will you chip in before it's to help ensure our efforts can continue?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61211765:JcUYpwVN0:m:1:3253819041:30AC21EE60486868EE49DE3916111ED2:r)**[ ](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61211765:JcUYpwVN0:m:1:3253819041:30AC21EE60486868EE49DE3916111ED2:r) Let me back up. My name is Matt Whitaker... I was appointed acting United States Attorney General under former President Trump. In that role, I protected Law and Order both at home and abroad. Today I am Co-Chair of the Center for Law & Justice at the America First Policy Institute, where we strive to protect and preserve the rule of law in this great Nation. Together, we will fight back against the radical Left and end its unjust weaponization of the FBI. The team at America First Policy Institute is the best in the Nation, and we're ready to make a HUGE difference for our country--ESPECIALLY when it comes to uncovering the truth regarding the FBI raid. [**I hope you 'll consider sending in a donation of $25, $35, or $50 today. ** ](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61211765:JcUYpwVN0:m:1:3253819041:30AC21EE60486868EE49DE3916111ED2:r) Sincerely, Matt Whitaker Co-Chair, Center for Law & Justice America First Policy Institute P.S. We've seen it time and time again. Castro's Cuba. Stalin's Russia. Nazi Germany. Mao's China. Great nations fall to tyranny when governments weaponize law enforcement against patriots and political opponents. [**I 'll fight with every breath to make sure that America doesn't have the same fate. Will you? ** ](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61211765:JcUYpwVN0:m:1:3253819041:30AC21EE60486868EE49DE3916111ED2:r)

| | | Peter,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $25 makes a difference. $25 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61212028:JdQHrwVNH:m:1:3317145305:C1E986D3AFBEDB2439536648F707BDA2:r "Johnson1")**_

Please, Peter, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

| | | Friend,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zch1l8lakrntd7q1dfbfh9ekkofq6a7k5rud1iq0_rp22sh2s8i66or2clgm2o77c3h2bs "Johnson1")**_

Please, Friend, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

subject: The Great Reset and socialism
body:
A few years ago, New York magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?” [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c920805%7c6937%7c7%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c0&wdmdk=PIwjdN9WNPc1bo3IaRWeGw&sysid=1)
| | | This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c74442%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=G027DMconfHfSRI2EMO%2bFA&sysid=1)
---
| |
Dear Fellow American, A few years ago, _New York _magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?” This is, of course, an exaggeration. But it makes clear that the far-Left in America aims to bring about a “Great Reset” of our economy and our way of life. In a recent issue of _Imprimis_ --Hillsdale College’s digest of liberty--author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of the Great Reset as “‘capitalism with Chinese characteristics’--a two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on top and socialism for the majority below.” Today, as a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand the extent of support for--and opposition to--socialism. Your input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight for the future of liberty in our country. **Will you please share your views on the political, social, and cultural forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below?** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c74443%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=r122YjEgFnSiBMihhoB53w&sysid=1)** Sadly, socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the young. You may be aware of a SHOCKING survey showing that... **. . . during the COVID-19 pandemic, support for socialism among those 16 to 23 years old jumped to 49 percent, and socialism also increased in popularity among all ages. ** **Why is this?** Draconian government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream come true for corporate socialists. At the same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures wherever it has been tried. This is a result of the far-Left’s “long march through the institutions”--including colleges and universities, K-12 schools, and the media. Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as school boards and even the military. But it is in our schools where the effects of critical race theory--which teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens according to race--are most dangerous. You may recall that many young Americans with college degrees who championed socialist policies participated in the riots and violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020. In the face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale’s work to **reach** and **teach** millions has never been more urgently needed. **That’s why I need your thoughts quickly. ** By responding to the **National Survey on Socialism **in the next five days**, **your honest opinions will help us understand the recent rise of socialism and develop our strategy to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. We hope to hear from friends representing every part of the country. Education is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your partnership with Hillsdale College is critical. As Winston Churchill said, “Socialism is the philosophy of failure, the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy.” If you agree, please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Socialism** today. **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c74443%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=r122YjEgFnSiBMihhoB53w&sysid=1)** Despite the recent successes of the far-Left, we must remember--**it is NEVER too late to defend liberty through education**. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled “The Second World Wars.” Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. | Dear Reader, As a former Goldman Sachs managing director, I feel it's my duty to _warn_ you about what may be coming on September 20th. **[It all starts with a new Presidential executive order, that may directly install MAJOR changes to your bank account.](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f74ada2ddddf40b9a50880f938d94625&_e=9FhJorgiYGSWYfxAkHW55QDlze_uFEWHX-80DmnCTOl2Id8isLXyLWyTYfn0dLNcFGMr2_8POHqwOi9HLGPN48DSqhQTNS6drtnmJw7RLsfJSXECq8dYCKB-zS38L7j5l3LNnsgKRqtKD0n9EXZQuXZNTd-ZZ6Q_roxOOn_osVoq-ebw25ERkmggjaOSYd-8mb6mss6QaejMnsFlrI0q0_y6hq-fZJads0QupByGSObSpw6pyHKj6DUkl5tzqzFQ)** And it's all backed by the biggest companies in the world: _Citigroup, Ford, MasterCard, Visa, and Coca-Cola._
| [](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f74ada2ddddf40b9a50880f938d94625&_e=9FhJorgiYGSWYfxAkHW55QDlze_uFEWHX-80DmnCTOl2Id8isLXyLWyTYfn0dLNcFGMr2_8POHqwOi9HLGPN48DSqhQTNS6drtnmJw7RLse4BF7hRjgoK2lGGS1y2EfB6JgC9RFMplCJdty1LYGgu0ybbWWFt3FPNaJ6UwKjMEzWfgo2FRzaa8x3arQbKJkL7LiueIcojD1Ew5uG8oPylEU-OhJmEsOYvjERMjMPh5hN8aPEVHyngW7q7QmP7iVo)
---

Unfortunately, there's not much time to prepare.

Stephen Roach, former chairman at Morgan Stanley, says: **["U.S. living standards are about to be squeezed as never before."](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f74ada2ddddf40b9a50880f938d94625&_e=9FhJorgiYGSWYfxAkHW55QDlze_uFEWHX-80DmnCTOl2Id8isLXyLWyTYfn0dLNcFGMr2_8POHqwOi9HLGPN48DSqhQTNS6drtnmJw7RLsdJO9T-oFJtN4BCQkGxU36VxTS88lj3RQHv9Vh9_FUG3NLeWFzeZPlBvFXYFKFIwpkrO7QThi2iCJDg56uM16y69QBH9iMByVxgm4GP3iIgM6Vxt1u2GbTmjO0ZaRQ3jKrz92Vts6QXKI9Ay-N8-Rw7)**
Listen, I'm not here to scare you...
But I am here to help you prepare.

I'll even reveal the exact steps I'm personally taking - **[click here for all the details.](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f74ada2ddddf40b9a50880f938d94625&_e=9FhJorgiYGSWYfxAkHW55QDlze_uFEWHX-80DmnCTOl2Id8isLXyLWyTYfn0dLNcFGMr2_8POHqwOi9HLGPN48DSqhQTNS6drtnmJw7RLsfzVJ0OBiAH4XD5h6yivCsyGbIwUYGutEirDVSiO71d8-TEif96X73p63-0ogZ4McddzVKd2bq3AOzQlx7TmW1MLXJsw5Fj7CA6198dBNLaAta7XBg1r01RbdfPq-L--T6b9P7OKPouyqX-twXbTMch)**
If you're worried about soaring inflation, rent increases, credit card debt, and a falling stock market...
**[Just wait until you see what's _NEXT_ for America...](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f74ada2ddddf40b9a50880f938d94625&_e=9FhJorgiYGSWYfxAkHW55QDlze_uFEWHX-80DmnCTOl2Id8isLXyLWyTYfn0dLNcFGMr2_8POHqwOi9HLGPN48DSqhQTNS6drtnmJw7RLscYFg81oU9zWTK93AkA9KqW7kOG3ngA45eq88nCGr0ocv4-D-pl2D1STACgtUycgKVebrnc_McmXBYdelnL8WZEGjVx-LE7hvDsxMr__gnhv0q87_LVsbFFxJerkfpVgGmosEcLzZLe6xSgVUQukcgj)**

Fellow Patriot, [**I urge you, right this second, to sign the National Petition for an Article V Convention of States to save America**.](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.) An army of conservative heroes including **_Mark Levin, Ben Shapiro, Sean Hannity,_** and** _Lt. Col. Allen West_** have joined our movement to call for an Article V Convention of States. [**Just click here to add your name to this national petition. And then PLEASE forward this email to every single person you know.**](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._GuT8wA)
---
[**Sign The Petition**](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.)
---
Our nation is spiraling out of control. Debt threatens to cripple our economy. Federal spending has never been higher — nor has our deficit. And the politicians in Washington won't do anything to save us. _In fact, most of them are part of the problem!_ A Convention of States is our only hope. You see, our Founding Fathers were brilliant men. They left an emergency clause in the Constitution in case the federal government got too big and out-of-control. **Article V of the Constitution allows the states to bypass Congress and the President to call a Convention of States to propose amendments to our Constitution that will rein in the federal government.** Well, conservative leaders all across the country — along with over **_FIVE MILLION_** grassroots patriots — believe it is time to invoke Article V and call a Convention of States for the express, _limited_ purpose of imposing fiscal restraints and term limits on Congress and limiting the power, scope, and jurisdiction of the federal government. And I hope you do, too. With the socialists in control in Washington, it's time to take action before it's too late! It's time for "We the People" to use the most powerful weapon in our arsenal - the Constitution - to fight back against Washington's overreach. [**Please sign the National Petition for an Article V Convention of States right now, and please ask everyone you know to do the same.**](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.--BA) Here at Convention of States Action, we are working overtime to convince the required 34 state legislatures to call for an Article V convention to place limits on the power and jurisdiction of the federal government. **We have already passed the COS Resolution through the state legislatures in 19 states, including four since the start of this year alone — bringing us over __HALFWAY__ to calling a Convention of States and taking the power back from the "ruling class" in Washington!** This year alone, the Resolution has passed out of committee in Massachusetts, Pennsylvania, Iowa, and Kansas — paving the way for the next round of states to pass! With dozens of states currently considering the COS Resolution, _NOW_ is our window of opportunity to double down and secure the needed victories to cross the finish line! We have a citizen activist army operating in all 50 states, working tirelessly to urge their state legislators to act in accordance with the will of the people and demand that they pass this critically important Resolution. **A Convention of States is our only chance to pass important and long overdue measures like a balanced budget amendment, term limits on Congress and the D.C. Swamp, and limits on the scope and jurisdiction of the federal government.** The politicians in Washington wouldn't dare limit their own power. Therefore, we the people need to do it! But in order for that to happen, we need millions and millions of patriotic Americans like you to sign this important national petition. We need to show the members of the state legislatures that the American people are ready for a constitutional solution as big as our nation's problems, an Article V Convention of States. [**Simply click here to sign and we'll deliver it directly to your state legislators, free of charge. This is our best chance to save America from an out-of-control federal government.**](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._6bRAu6mLqCz07iVo5A) Washington won't fix itself. The federal government is too big, and the politicians are too invested in its growth. We the people must take control through our state legislatures. [**Please join the fight to call a Convention of States. Sign the petition today, and urge every freedom-loving American to do the same.**](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.-TLcNdvaLG_vzmkKQ)
---
[**Sign The Petition**](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.)
---
Thank you, and may God bless America! For America, Mark MecklerPresidentConvention of States Action

Peter:
Missouri's conservative State Attorney General, **Eric Schmitt** (R-MO), has won the Republican nomination for U.S. Senate. And unlike the Republican leadership in the Senate, we are working harder than ever to win a _**conservative**_ majority this year!
Eric Schmitt ran in a crowded field of candidates and won a come-from-behind victory in a critical battleground state that will determine control of the Senate.
Now, he faces liberal Anheuser-Busch heiress **Trudy Busch Valentine** (D-MO) in the November election. Valentine has a fortune to spend in this race, and you can be sure the Left's entire political machine will be working day and night to defeat Eric Schmitt.
**[Please support Eric Schmitt's grassroots campaign today!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61216562:6CciGwVNa:m:1:3317145305:C99A5647C089EBBDDE37ABFC9EA39180:r)**
_Individuals can give up to $2,900 to Schmitt's general election campaign, but any amount will help, no matter how small._
**The only way for him to compete financially is for us to use the strength of our numbers and bundle thousands of small-dollar donations together for him.**
**[So please take action right now and support one of the strongest conservative Senate candidates in the nation.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61216562:6CciGwVNa:m:1:3317145305:C99A5647C089EBBDDE37ABFC9EA39180:r)**
Eric Schmitt is a tough, principled constitutional conservative who has fought for the rights of individuals against anti-American, anti-family elites colluding against them. During his tenure as Missouri's Attorney General, Schmitt has been everywhere.
✓ When Democrats manipulated 2020 election rules, Schmitt leaped into the fray, leading other state attorneys general to support election integrity lawsuits in Pennsylvania and Texas.
✓ When school boards tried to force students to wear masks against their parents' objections, Schmitt took them to court on behalf of kids, families, and true science.
✓ When Big Tech firms colluded to cancel conservatives from their platforms, Schmitt launched one of the nation's most extensive investigations into their discriminatory business practices.
✓ When woke activists attacked a Missouri high school football coach for leading his players in prayer before a game, Schmitt defended the coach and made clear to school officials that he did nothing wrong under the law or the Constitution.
✓ Schmitt was also the first Attorney General to sue the Chinese Community Party and the Wuhan Institute of Virology for their criminal negligence, coverups, and lies stemming from the origins of the Covid-19 pandemic.
These were all fights of choice by Eric Schmitt. He didn't have to wage them, and there were plenty of reasons not to. Big donors and the media don't like culture warriors, don't like holding leftists accountable.

**But Eric Schmitt doesn 't work for them - he works for the people. As Attorney General, he put Missouri families first. And in the Senate, he will put America First.**
**[Please help send Eric Schmitt to the U.S. Senate.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61216562:6CciGwVNa:m:1:3317145305:C99A5647C089EBBDDE37ABFC9EA39180:r)**
The most important job for senators in 2023 won't be passing bills - not with Joe Biden in the White House for two more years. No, it will be investigations - subpoenaing documents, deposing witnesses, finding whistleblowers, and holding hearings. And we need a fighter like Eric Schmitt to do it.
For all Biden's scandals, there's much we still don't know about:
▶︎ Hunter Biden's shady business dealings.
▶︎ The border crisis and the location of illegal immigrants.
▶︎ Anthony Fauci's role in the development of Covid-19.
▶︎ The FBI's targeting of parents as "domestic terrorists."
▶︎ White House collusion with Big Tech on censoring conservatives.
No one will pursue the truth more doggedly than Eric Schmitt. He will join Ted Cruz, Mike Lee, Rand Paul, Ron Johnson, and others in uncovering the facts about how Joe Biden, the Democrats, and the media are trying to steal our freedom and destroy everything that made America great.
Join SCF in supporting Schmitt in Missouri's Senate race this year. He is precisely what we need in Washington right now: a fighter, a truth-teller, and a defender of America's Constitution and culture.
**[Please contribute $25, $35, $50, or more to Eric Schmitt today!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61216562:6CciGwVNa:m:1:3317145305:C99A5647C089EBBDDE37ABFC9EA39180:r)**
_SCF will pay all processing fees and transfer 100% of your contribution to his campaign._
Thank you for being part of our team and for doing so much to help build a conservative Senate. Sincerely,

Matt Hoskins Senior Advisor Senate Conservatives Fund

subject: Sharing the Keep Idaho IDAHO Plan
disclaimer_text: Paid for by [Ammon Bundy for Governor](https://www
body:
| | [](https://www.votebundy.com)
---
| Peter,First, _thank you for your continued support_! We simply cannot win this battle without YOU!Second, we've been hard at work building resources that will make it easier and more effective for you to share the [Keep Idaho IDAHO Plan](https://www.votebundy.com/about/keep-idaho-idaho-plan/) with your family, friends and neighbors. Below are a few enhancements we recently made to the campaign website ([votebundy.com](https://www.votebundy.com)) to assist you in this effort.

* * *
**Main Menu Item** Now, _right at the top of every page_ , the _first_ item in the main menu is a link to [The Plan](https://www.votebundy.com/about/keep-idaho-idaho-plan/)...

* * *
**Side Panel Links** On almost every page of the website is a side panel with a more prominent link to the [Keep Idaho IDAHO Plan](https://www.votebundy.com/about/keep-idaho-idaho-plan/). Clicking the cover image or the text below will take visitors to the [textual version of the plan](https://www.votebundy.com/about/keep-idaho-idaho-plan/?read)...... and clicking the new page carousel will take visitors to [a _visual guide_ through the Keep Idaho IDAHO Plan](https://www.votebundy.com/about/keep-idaho-idaho-plan/view).

* * *
**Visual Guide** This more [_eye-pleasing and summarized_ version of the Keep Idaho IDAHO Plan](https://www.votebundy.com/about/keep-idaho-idaho-plan/view) features relevant images, and easy to read charts and graphs to help readers understand the principles and ideas contained in the plan. Each page can be enlarged for easy reading...[](https://www.votebundy.com/about/keep-idaho-idaho-plan/view)

* * *
**Section Shortcuts** And, best of all, each section of the [Keep Idaho IDAHO Plan](https://www.votebundy.com/about/keep-idaho-idaho-plan/) now has simple, easy-to-remember shortcuts (web addresses) that can be used to refer others _directly_ to a specific section of the plan...[](https://www.votebundy.com/about/keep-idaho-idaho-plan/shortcuts)A simple list of these shortcuts can be viewed using the link below. _Please make an effort to remember at least one for each section_ so you can easily share them when you're sending emails or letters to the editor, or even _verbally_ sharing details of [the Keep Idaho IDAHO Plan](https://www.votebundy.com/about/keep-idaho-idaho-plan/) with others.

[votebundy.com/about/keep-idaho-idaho-plan/shortcuts](https://www.votebundy.com/about/keep-idaho-idaho-plan/shortcuts)

* * *
**Other Important Links** The website, as you know, is loaded with content: [recent interviews of Ammon](https://www.votebundy.com/media/interviews/), [campaign videos](https://www.votebundy.com/media/videos/), [endorsements](https://www.votebundy.com/about/endorsements/), a list of [frequently asked questions](https://www.votebundy.com/about/faq/), common [lies and smears](https://www.votebundy.com/about/lies-and-smears/) that are often told about Ammon, etc - all great to share with those not yet familiar with why _this election is so important_ if we are to remain a free people, and Idaho is to remain... well... IDAHO! Let's work together to keep it that way.Oh, and we've also added over 300 photos of [recent campaign activity](https://www.votebundy.com/media/campaign-photos/) all over the state! Great job folks! Keep it up, and let freedom ring!
In Liberty,**The Ammon Bundy for Governor Team**
\---**PS** : Be sure to join us at the [Keep Idaho IDAHO Rally in the Treasure Valley](https://www.votebundy.com/events/keep-idaho-idaho-rally/nampa/) event **THIS SATURDAY** , **SEPTEMBER 10TH @ 4PM** in **NAMPA!** More details can be found here: <https://www.votebundy.com/events/keep-idaho-idaho-rally/nampa/>

* * *

name: Kari Lake
subject: The problem is the whole damn system
body:
What is it with the establishment elites HIDING from the people? [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c920805%7c6938%7c7%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c0&wdmdk=JhrmxOgGiJY36it%2fPjzssA&sysid=1)
| | | [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c85556%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=u5dV%2frke5YkkYaKserRyDw&sysid=1)
---
| | Friend, What is it with the establishment elites HIDING from the people? Joe Biden's been in the basement for months. He pops out - delivers a massively unpopular plan for student loan forgiveness - and goes back to avoiding the public. That peek-a-boo act must be written into the official Democrat playbook because my opponent, Katie Hobbs, is doing the exact same thing! She refuses to debate. She refuses to show her face to the people of Arizona. If she's not making a plea to the radical left for more Soros money to fund her campaign, no one hears from her at all. This unaccountable, ridiculous behavior is so typical of a political establishment that does not value the voice of the people. _[**FIGHT BACK >>**](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c85557%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=hn0iKUF3sagPfFIxIr4ZPA&sysid=1)_ Now, it should be clear by now... **I'm not hiding.** That’s because**I’M NOT AFRAID.** I speak with the people every day because I believe that WE THE PEOPLE deserve to hear from both sides and get a fair idea of who will stand for you and who won't. _The silence is deafening. _ While conservative leaders like me on the NEW RIGHT are open books... The failing establishment elites are closed doors.
It’s time for us to say OUT WITH THE OLD, and in with the NEW (RIGHT) so we can SAVE AMERICA from these out-of-touch narcissists. **__[Are you with me?](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c85558%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=S8f%2fgj6zb1gOwTCdxynI%2fQ&sysid=1)_ _**
---
[**SUPPORT KARI LAKE NOW >>**](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c85559%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=38ts9kldDcwecRroaletCA&sysid=1)
---
I'm telling you right now that I am a strong conservative who can get things done. I’m the transformative leadership we need. _But you don't need to just take my word for it. _ **I'm endorsed by:**
* * * * * * President Donald Trump
* Governor Ron DeSantis
* Rudy Giuliani
* Marjorie Taylor Green
* Sheriff Joe Arpaio
* Richard Grenell
* General Michael Flynn, and more...

---
[**JOIN PRESIDENT TRUMP: SUPPORT KARI LAKE >>**](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c85550%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Sl3xWVK6miLI6I9BmmRXHw&sysid=1)
---
Together, we’re going to unite to solve the problems America is facing right now. And trust me... there’s a lot to do.
_But I know I can make it happen because I’ve always been able to do anything I set my mind to. And that’s not going to stop now!_
---
[](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c85551%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=7ctrMf%2bkQni%2bSc1ktbhIwA&sysid=1)
---
I grew up in Iowa. There’s not a lot to do there, but that’s where I honed my work ethic. I worked hard. I learned to fight. I gained that fighting spirit the old establishment GOP never had -- that’s what makes me a part of the NEW RIGHT. I developed that backbone of steel - that “BDE” that President Trump and Governor Ron DeSantis have. And frankly, that we want all of our elected leaders to have. Someone even recently told me “Kari, you’re going to be the DeSantis of the West.” Other than being called “Trump in a Dress -- which is my favorite compliment of all -- that is the greatest compliment you could pay me. **To me, that means that you know when you elect me, you’re going to get someone who fights for you every single day. ** We are going to be so effective in Arizona.
---
[**SUPPORT KARI LAKE >>**](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c85552%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=7WIYFonU9Ft9lm8HzO3feA&sysid=1)
---
**Friend, I promise you this, as the governor of Arizona, I will be the biggest pain in the ass Joe Biden’s ever experienced. ** I will unite with conservatives across the country to protect Arizona from this out-of-control federal government. We will save our states and return the power to WE, THE PEOPLE, where it belongs. **_This is our moment to make it happen. _**
---
Friend, let’s not forget that the race for Governor of Arizona is one of the most important fights in the entire country. ** ** It’s our chance to prove to corporate media that we are stronger than the lies. ** ** It’s our chance to prove to the establishment elite that the NEW RIGHT is here to stay. ** ** And it’s our chance to SECURE OUR BORDER, defend our small businesses, defeat inflation, end leftist indoctrination and get our nation back on track. ** ** Though the results took longer than they should have, Arizonans who have been forgotten by the establishment already delivered a POLITICAL EARTHQUAKE in the GOP primary. We won every single county in Arizona! ** ** Now, all eyes are on us. ** ** It’s game time. ** ** And I need you on my side. ** ** **_[Will you support our momentum?](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c85553%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=poJh85Ck97UGnaUIEdLBVg&sysid=1)___**
---
Now, I don’t care if you’re with the Democrat Party, the Independent Party, the Republican Party, the Pizza Party, or the Pool Party - our policies are going to help every American. **_[We have to stand together and defeat the left so we can save America. ](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c85554%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=MO%2bIk8uaRkMUs1lptyrOpA&sysid=1)_** I hope that you will chip in now to support my campaign for Governor of Arizona.**__**
---
[**SAVE AMERICA: SUPPORT KARI LAKE >>**](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c85565%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=PwXbkzZuD%2bzSLoelQtV36w&sysid=1)
---
Sincerely,

body:
Last week I went to Pennsylvania to campaign for my good friend Doug Mastriano
[View this message in your browser](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2znppt7k31vctn71iolj4ko7hocbisop0g07v7po0_rp22sh2s8i66or2clhm1oj1cph238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpqedtge1p7adjkm4qj7cbkmgor79hnmmrq8cjm62qb6t9nkjhf4onmmdqrcp9nchj33cb0m5p3ap5hehobbcb263gb0tbmehon7cjiempj2ojlejjjfduie1p68dhgm9j74t1hepge1d3563gbacb4spj6cc9gmdi3fcjgcpqeeddm6uobapbi4no)

| | | | | | | | | [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zkh0fkaibhardgtj50likabp8no2kkgmrdt0vd80_rp22sh2s8i66or2clhm1oj1cph2bs)
---
| Friend,
Last week, I went to Pennsylvania to **campaign for my good friend, Doug Mastriano** , the Republican nominee for Governor of Pennsylvania.
Doug’s a **principled defender of conservative values, liberty, and the American Dream**...and I know that he’ll govern by putting freedom first, just like I do down here in Florida.
Doug’s **down by just 3 points** in the polls, but his opponent has a _ton_ of money to dump into this race, as well as the unified support of Big Tech and the Leftist Media.
**Doug needs our immediate help if he’s going to pull off a big victory on November 8.**
I told Doug my top supporters could always be trusted to come through for a true conservative fighter...
**[As a special favor to me, will you rush your support to Doug’s campaign...and make sure he has the resources to fight back and win?](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zf8ch3o6v1uqsck1v3pdets3fs2d5u625qs1fof8_rp22sh2s8i66or2clhm1oj1cph2bs)** | | | | [DONATE TO DOUG](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zm1er8ngk04jmr41sg238jjge48u2ttkgs1mtilo_rp22sh2s8i66or2clhm1oj1cph2bs)
---
Back in 2018, **polls said I would lose by 7%** and the Leftist media had **all but written me off.**

Support from _conservatives like you_ helped prove them wrong...and I’m sure you’d agree: **Florida would be a MUCH worse place today if we had come up short.**
* When the rest of the nation locked down for COVID-19, **Florida empowered our people** and stayed open.

name: Cliff Schecter, Blue Amp Action
subject: Should we give up on these House seats?
body:
Urgent: 5-7 congressional seats are on the line
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| | | | | Peter, have you seen this? I know it’s hard to keep track of all their shenanigans, but ... The Republicans are trying to steal their way to a House majority. _I know this won't surprise you, that the party of coups, corruption and stealing classified documents has ignored crystal-clear court rulings to try to steal House seats. It isn't like they haven't obscenely gerrymandered in the past. This is how they built their majority in 2010, after all. _ [**Can you join me in giving $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford to the Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee (DCCC) so that we can ensure we hold the House--even increase our majority--and can stop them from stealing their way to a House majority this time, or ever again?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T9a9fcfdf-f493-4c82-8d53-343462f2e248/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) But now, as authoritarians do, they've purposely run out the clock to ignore our courts until we pass dates when district lines must be set. Our Supreme Court, when it's bothered to say anything, said it's "too close to an election" to make them change district lines, rewarding their delaying tactics of ignoring clear rulings REQUIRING THEM TO DRAW ADDITIONAL BLACK MAJORITY DISTRICTS. Yet another betrayal by our insane, illegitimate, right-wing Supreme Court, and an incredibly dangerous precedent for our democracy. **In a piece in The Huffington Post, it's clear that these tactics could give Republicans 5-7 additional House seats, just because they refused to follow the law.** In Alabama, Louisiana and Georgia, the Black populations are 27%, 33% & 33% respectively, so based on The Voting Rights Act, our Constitution and, well, math, a quarter to a third of the districts in these states must be majority Black. Yet, Republican state legislators who obviously hate democracy have gerrymandered to only allow one majority Black district in each state, and now the Supreme Court has allowed them to get away with it.
---
|
---
| | | | [DONATE NOW: DEMOCRATIC CONGRESSIONAL CAMPAIGN COMMITTEE](https://default.salsalabs.org/T25bc6a14-dd26-454a-a635-ed6176cab969/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| **In my home state of Ohio, something similar was done, after the Ohio Supreme Court found several GOP maps to not be representative of the 47% average Democrats receive in statewide votes here, and in violation of a constitutional amendment we overwhelmingly passed in 2018 requiring fair districts.** Republicans have again and again used delay tactics to get close enough to the election so they don't have to make the changes demanded by Ohio's Supreme Court so Democrats are looking at a likelihood of ending up with 5-6 seats, instead of the 9 that we should. We obviously can't let them get away with this. When they start using delay tactics to blatantly ignore our courts, what do our laws even mean anymore? So, look, on the bright side we've seen incredible results in Kansas rejecting an effort to ban abortion, and in New York and Alaska where Democrats won Republican seats. We're fired up! We need to take this energy and destroy them in November--to win so many damn Republican seats they can't take the House, and along with a Senate that ends the filibuster we pass federal legislation that'll never allow them to pull this crap again. [**Can you join me in giving $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford to the Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee (DCCC) so that we can ensure we hold the House--even increase our majority--and can stop them from stealing their way to a House majority this time, or ever again?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T49e7d3cb-7ab6-49f3-bd14-3383c5315843/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _Thank you for supporting Blue Amp Action's efforts to protect our democracy. And please enjoy the rest of your Labor Day Weekend._ Cliff

Fellow Conservative,

**The same Democrat party that just authorized the unprecedented FBI raid of President Trump’s home over “documents” just voted to give the IRS enough of your hard-earned money to hire 87,000 new IRS agents to come after the rest of us.**

**In what world is 87,000 new IRS agents a priority for our country?**

Sure, the Democrats claim they are just trying to squeeze every possible penny they can out of the American people to fund Biden’s dangerous agenda.**But I think there is much, much more to this power grab.**

**Ask yourself this:** __Why not use that same $80 billion to hire 87,000 new border patrol agents instead? Better yet, why not let people keep their own hard-earned money for themselves and their families?__

**Please let me know if I can count on you as an ally in the effort to stop the Biden/Pelosi agenda that is taking our money, our freedom, and our country.[I’m asking you to be among 8,700 conservatives to sign a petition to stop the government funding for the 87,000 new IRS agents. Can I count on your signature between now and Friday.](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=d28cf3fade6c486a942c00017ad74efe&_e=sWpftsGxgHaFHtYFUFxmzk5IsSP8bb78riTOxZcrq5ucusxa4iqxIOFtqK0OXJw8inBBkFvUMe5uvMtC8dF5VSoaYNAbe_uH-Gy1C0_B7uQlnz3jMdLbCVnH8kNn6UMoPX8Jt5wKy6QJh3OpY7WEDyiVUxIk4EWS9oQMq7XmmEHozx64jkpigMXEwm_k4d8XQIO_6eIxHEDvN_tikggZx8trVK-WnbbQn0c1EKrApv_3a2K_i_qBmJI4l9wkRVsCoVHQ29jUhEgDmV2aPblsjGnL9-CKKn5QhMWLUr2EgKm1C6MJDzrt5g5MTP-H4dyY)**

[** SIGN MY IRS PETITION BEFORE FRIDAY ➞ **](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=d28cf3fade6c486a942c00017ad74efe&_e=sWpftsGxgHaFHtYFUFxmzk5IsSP8bb78riTOxZcrq5ucusxa4iqxIOFtqK0OXJw8inBBkFvUMe5uvMtC8dF5VSoaYNAbe_uH-Gy1C0_B7uQlnz3jMdLbCVnH8kNn6UMoPX8Jt5wKy6QJh3OpY7WED8XHRVWS6ky3o4mC2kZ6arzwUGCqFzp0kl_E_-5KRdLtXKwshVifvz-cSUf9v8LuJqPwLhzI-NkLrpnGAqQgayY-ougFb5A4QtDknD3QyEk4QgLOeOuczG7DV6vQSg3G3tnW7mGBGvjdJk83QKl51HSfG-EShJXo7srynwRVfpiI)
**Yes, showering the IRS with funds is about Democrats wanting more of our hard-earned money.** But to me, it’s just as much about the fundamental choice that Americans have faced since our founding. It’s about more freedom vs. more government control. **It’s about whether we serve the government ... or whether the government serves us.**

I need to hear from you today: **do you support Republicans taking control of the House in November, to stop this madness and return freedom, power and money back to the people?**

Hi Derek,

While we don't always agree on each and every strategy, campaign workers agree on one thing: **Things kick into high gear after Labor Day****.** When school is back and communities pivot away from summer, campaign season heats up.
**Here's what that means:** From voter engagement to canvassing and fundraising, our campaign strategy relies on a big leap starting right now.

Over the summer, we were knocking on a few thousand doors per weekend. This fall, **we need to****knock on 10,000 doors per weekend** so that we can speak to each of our "persuasion targets" before Election Day. Through one-on-one conversations with neighbors, we need them to learn about Chrissy – the best person to represent PA-06 and fight for working families.
The stakes are incredibly high: Republicans only need five seats to retake the House majority. But together, we can show them that they’re fighting against serious momentum in PA-06.

**Hi friend — Did you know personalized postcards are one of the best ways to reach out to voters across PA-01 and mobilize them to vote this November?** It’s a quick and meaningful way to connect with voters. But here’s the thing, not every volunteer can afford the cost of postage stamps. That’s why we launched a postcard campaign to supply postage for our network of grassroots volunteers. This past weekend and yesterday, three shootings rocked the Lowcountry—including one in our district. This past weekend and yesterday, three shootings rocked the Lowcountry—including one in our district. Every time a shooting happens, it floods me with memories of the gun violence victims I’ve seen and sparks outrage that in regions like ours, our representative voted against every common-sense gun violence prevention measure that’s gone through Congress. It’s heartbreaking and enraging to see gun violence destroy families and harm our children while politicians like Nancy Mace ignore this incredibly important issue, proudly labeling herself a “Second Amendment Girl.” | | There’s no reason why we should live like this. No one should have to be afraid to go to a mall, church, school, or any public place because of a lack of common-sense gun legislation. Nancy Mace voted against the Safer Communities Act which is now the first law to prevent gun violence in decades, apparently too busy flaunting her NRA endorsement to give a damn about what happens to Lowcountry families. This is why we need to take action. Thank you, Dr. Annie | = | = Paid for by Dr. Annie Andrews for Congress Dr. Annie Andrews for Congress PO BOX 1431 Johns Island, SC 29457 United States **

| | | Friend,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z7rglcdcg6ds9dce1o7t353h74sl15ddi7ce1ld0_rp22sh2s8i66or2cljm4pr4cdh2bs "Johnson1")**_

Please, Friend, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

Peter, have you visited Tampico? | | | Hi Peter – In case you haven't heard the news, United Rural Democrats moved its headquarters to Tampico, Illinois, and we wanted to give you a first look around our new home! **You might know Tampico as the birthplace of Ronald Reagan, and what better place to start rebuilding Democratic strongholds than a town at the heart of the Republican rural takeover?** Tampico is located around 110 miles west of Chicago, with a population of approximately 770 residents. Though we're still setting up shop at our new headquarters, we've already come to know Tampico as a town full of history, welcoming people, and some great food (catch us at The Break Room Pub n Grub after work). We have also loved exploring the local parks in Tampico, where community residents organize yoga sessions and organize neighborhood events. The URD team has grown up in towns just like Tampico, which is why we know exactly what's at stake if we can't organize Democrats to make progress in rural America. **Peter, I know you care about helping Democrats win in rural America. Peter:
Missouri's conservative State Attorney General, **Eric Schmitt** (R-MO), has won the Republican nomination for U.S. Senate. And unlike the Republican leadership in the Senate, we are working harder than ever to win a _**conservative**_ majority this year!
Eric Schmitt ran in a crowded field of candidates and won a come-from-behind victory in a critical battleground state that will determine control of the Senate.
Now, he faces liberal Anheuser-Busch heiress **Trudy Busch Valentine** (D-MO) in the November election. Valentine has a fortune to spend in this race, and you can be sure the Left's entire political machine will be working day and night to defeat Eric Schmitt.
**[Please support Eric Schmitt's grassroots campaign today!](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61216681:6AfNDwVNH:m:1:3331421248:EA2DC93CC8794AA5041910824E1585ED:r)**
_Individuals can give up to $2,900 to Schmitt's general election campaign, but any amount will help, no matter how small._
**The only way for him to compete financially is for us to use the strength of our numbers and bundle thousands of small-dollar donations together for him.**
**[So please take action right now and support one of the strongest conservative Senate candidates in the nation.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61216681:6AfNDwVNH:m:1:3331421248:EA2DC93CC8794AA5041910824E1585ED:r)**
Eric Schmitt is a tough, principled constitutional conservative who has fought for the rights of individuals against anti-American, anti-family elites colluding against them. During his tenure as Missouri's Attorney General, Schmitt has been everywhere.
✓ When Democrats manipulated 2020 election rules, Schmitt leaped into the fray, leading other state attorneys general to support election integrity lawsuits in Pennsylvania and Texas.
✓ When school boards tried to force students to wear masks against their parents' objections, Schmitt took them to court on behalf of kids, families, and true science.
✓ When Big Tech firms colluded to cancel conservatives from their platforms, Schmitt launched one of the nation's most extensive investigations into their discriminatory business practices.
✓ When woke activists attacked a Missouri high school football coach for leading his players in prayer before a game, Schmitt defended the coach and made clear to school officials that he did nothing wrong under the law or the Constitution.
✓ Schmitt was also the first Attorney General to sue the Chinese Community Party and the Wuhan Institute of Virology for their criminal negligence, coverups, and lies stemming from the origins of the Covid-19 pandemic.
These were all fights of choice by Eric Schmitt. He didn't have to wage them, and there were plenty of reasons not to. Big donors and the media don't like culture warriors, don't like holding leftists accountable.

**But Eric Schmitt doesn 't work for them - he works for the people. As Attorney General, he put Missouri families first. And in the Senate, he will put America First.**
**[Please help send Eric Schmitt to the U.S. Senate.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61216681:6AfNDwVNH:m:1:3331421248:EA2DC93CC8794AA5041910824E1585ED:r)**
The most important job for senators in 2023 won't be passing bills - not with Joe Biden in the White House for two more years. No, it will be investigations - subpoenaing documents, deposing witnesses, finding whistleblowers, and holding hearings. And we need a fighter like Eric Schmitt to do it.
For all Biden's scandals, there's much we still don't know about:
▶︎ Hunter Biden's shady business dealings.
▶︎ The border crisis and the location of illegal immigrants.
▶︎ Anthony Fauci's role in the development of Covid-19.
▶︎ The FBI's targeting of parents as "domestic terrorists."
▶︎ White House collusion with Big Tech on censoring conservatives.
No one will pursue the truth more doggedly than Eric Schmitt. He will join Ted Cruz, Mike Lee, Rand Paul, Ron Johnson, and others in uncovering the facts about how Joe Biden, the Democrats, and the media are trying to steal our freedom and destroy everything that made America great.
Join SCF in supporting Schmitt in Missouri's Senate race this year. He is precisely what we need in Washington right now: a fighter, a truth-teller, and a defender of America's Constitution and culture.
**[Please contribute $25, $35, $50, or more to Eric Schmitt today!](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61216681:6AfNDwVNH:m:1:3331421248:EA2DC93CC8794AA5041910824E1585ED:r)**
_SCF will pay all processing fees and transfer 100% of your contribution to his campaign._
Thank you for being part of our team and for doing so much to help build a conservative Senate. Sincerely,
---

Matt Hoskins Senior Advisor Senate Conservatives Fund

“The best I can describe it, is if you go in a porta potty, on a hot day, and you sit in it for 10 hours.” | | | Peter, **UPS drivers have suffered from heatstroke, heat exhaustion, dehydration, and even death during heat waves this summer — simply because UPS doesn’t want to incur the expense of providing air conditioning.** And heat waves will only become more widespread in the coming years as a consequence of climate change. Trucks without air conditioning have _already_ led to deadly consequences. Together, Derek, we accomplished what some people called impossible. We won the White House, flipped the Senate, passed historic legislation like the _Inflation Reduction Act_ , confirmed Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson as the first Black woman to the United States Supreme Court, and so much more. **Joe understood the power of coalitions -- and that’s why we turned to you. Together, we unified Americans across the country, and with your help, we have won again and again. It’s nothing short of extraordinary, and I’m so grateful that you chose to be a part of our team.** Our work isn’t finished, however. In just a couple of months, millions of Americans will vote in the midterm elections, and the choices they make will set the course of our country for the next two years. If we want to continue the incredible progress Joe has already made, we’ve got to get to work. From Congress to state houses to county elections, Democrats are fighting extremists in critical elections, and they need your support. It won’t be easy, but we’ve seen what’s possible when we come together. Joe, Kamala, Doug and I are working hard to win in November, and with your help, Derek, we can win. So, let’s get to work, and I’ll see you on the campaign trail. Thank you for all you do, Jill Jill Biden

It’s nothing short of extraordinary, and I’m so grateful that you chose to be a part of our team. Our work isn’t finished, however. In just a couple of months, millions of Americans will vote in the midterm elections, and the choices they make will set the course of our country for the next two years. If we want to continue the incredible progress Joe has already made, we’ve got to get to work. From Congress to state houses to county elections, Democrats are fighting extremists in critical elections, and they need your support. It won’t be easy, but we’ve seen what’s possible when we come together. Joe, Kamala, Doug and I are working hard to win in November, and with your help, Derek, we can win. So, let’s get to work, and I’ll see you on the campaign trail. Thank you for all you do, Jill Jill Biden Manage how often you receive DNC emails, . Fellow American,My name is James Judge, and I am officially your Republican nominee for U.S. Congress in Florida’s 14th Congressional District.I’m taking on Rep. Kathy Castor, an increasingly radical Democrat, who has served in Washington for almost 18 years.**I’m running on a platform of sanity and term limits**.I want less government and more freedom for all Americans, and especially for the people of Florida’s 14th District.I am a Christian, conservative Republican, but I am not a “yes man” for any establishment. _I am simply a normal American small businessman and veteran, and like you, I’m worried about the direction of our country._ Over the past few years – and particularly in the past weeks – American politics have become more hostile than ever.President Biden called those of us who supported President Trump “extremists” who are a “threat” to the very existence of this country.**That is extremely dangerous rhetoric, and my opponent Kathy Castor will not denounce Biden because she agrees with him.** Those of us who want to secure the blessings of liberty, protect our constitutional rights, end reckless government spending, pay down our debt and put a stop to this out-of-control inflation that is hurting the working class are not “extremists.”We are conservative Americans, and we will not back down, despite the threatening language coming from the left.[**I need your support today, and I’m asking you to contribute to my campaign to help me bring sanity back to Washington**](https://judgepr.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=11d59c1f2d&e=00028e5542).Right now, we’re seeing skyrocketing prices for food and fuel.We haven’t seen anything like this in half a century. It’s hurting working families and small businesses most.It’s the failure of the insane Democrat policies that have caused this mess, and we need to clean it up before we have crushing hyperinflation.**That’s what I intend to do, but I can’t do it without your help**.[**Chip into my election campaign today, and let’s get America back on track**](https://judgepr.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=71819eda7a&e=00028e5542).The bottom line is this: Americans should be able to live in peace without being threatened by the President, and without the bloated Washington nanny state intruding in their lives.Americans should also be able to fill their tanks and out food on their tables without worrying whether they’ll be able to make rent or pay their mortgages.[**I need you to help me make this vision for our country become a reality**](https://judgepr.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=00b96e41d7&e=00028e5542)**.**[**By chipping in $5, $10, $25, $50, $100 or more to my election campaign today, you’ll be doing just that**](https://judgepr.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=2a6cfe8a4e&e=00028e5542).Thank you in advance for your generous support.Humbly,James Judge

Florida’s 14th Congressional District

name: Pro Life Update
subject: Unlock the Federalist Papers
body:
The events of the last year have no precedent in our nation’s history.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2znat80bntreqtreeb36jb59chqcvsp6opu2juimg_rp22sh2s8i66or2clge0o34c1h238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq0sjnm6qb6d9le1oj8cbl6ej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hffdbl61rmedpnclrj9o31chgn9ojme4qn9cj1msqj4cdmmqrr4tthcpij6stn6srt4s3ic9j71cj6e3ib6or7m9p6ccdn6ko6fdj1coq61cj6c3gbaor0s2qj2cdl66qn49fg)
This sponsored message from Pro Life Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z6qq5edmlic9g3deau923q3vt62oft64ode3jao0_rp22sh2s8i66or2clge0o34c1h2bs) Dear Fellow American, The events of the last year have no precedent in our nation’s history. They’ve shaken me, and I’m sure they’ve affected you as well. Throughout it all, you may have noticed a recurring theme from the progressives in the media, Big Tech, and politics. They insist that the government designed by our Founding Fathers, as expressed in the Constitution, is **flawed** and **outdated** —not adequate for the challenges of our time. How should defenders of the Constitution, like you and me, respond to such charges? Well, a few early champions of the Constitution—Alexander Hamilton, John Jay, and James Madison—have given you the guide: _The Federalist Papers_. Written between October 1787 and August 1788 under the pen name Publius, _The Federalist Papers_ were originally published as newspaper editorials intended to explain the merits of the Constitution. Thomas Jefferson described _The Federalist Papers_ as “the best commentary on the principles of government which ever was written.” That means that defenders of the Constitution have no better help in understanding the principles of liberty underlying our Constitution than the words of the Founders themselves. **So, I’d like to send you our entire 10-lesson course, “ _The Federalist Papers_ ,”on DVD today with a donation of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.** _**“The Federalist Papers”**_ course comes in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or a small group. You might also find it useful for a homeschool curriculum or personal study. It’s taught by Hillsdale’s knowledgeable faculty and will deepen your understanding of this incredibly relevant document even more. The DVD can also make an excellent gift for a friend or family member unfamiliar with our nation’s founding principles of liberty. [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zc9r6s7guu9tnl3tq4bbrtlh1m1hckl646rt74tg_rp22sh2s8i66or2clge0o34c1h2bs) Supplies are limited, though, so get this special edition of **_“The Federalist Papers”_** on DVD today. Given that more than 200,000 people have taken this course already, you can bet the DVD box set won’t last long. Click here to learn more about this DVD and order your copy of _**“The Federalist Papers”**_ today: [**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-federalist-papers**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zle6u445qa2o3bsds2purs9vl9qgqrnco9r1bon0_rp22sh2s8i66or2clge0o34c1h2bs) Warm regards, Bill Gray Class of 2001 Associate Vice President of National Donor Outreach Hillsdale College

body:
The politicians in Washington wouldn't dare limit their own power. Therefore, we the people need to do it!
[View this message in your browser](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zds5u5opanmsbrnm20vcjhsk6c9a4rpkv8a6212o_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t56ej3fctmekp76t1heipnacpne4pqcdtlmui34thgmipnadt4sbp65sj16or36djim5p64tbl6cpr1d5keirr6splmoo7edtk6lrmcdbi6lob2pj7c1jjfkjge9h6cs5icpoe9cr3cup74phhmaqr9o3nc1j7co5icpge1db3c3gbac9hmkorash1k8gn48n24hhm6oj5ctie9o70s8iv0)

---
Fellow Patriot, [**I urge you, right this second, to sign the National Petition for an Article V Convention of States to save America**.](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zl4jfv11dtq84s5om0h3vnnjebjs75s55cl5shu0_rp22sh2s8i66or2cljm9p70s3h2bs) An army of conservative heroes including **_Mark Levin, Ben Shapiro, Sean Hannity,_** and** _Lt. Col. Allen West_** have joined our movement to call for an Article V Convention of States. [**Just click here to add your name to this national petition. And then PLEASE forward this email to every single person you know.**](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zv4qrd3vb3qltp8nbk7qoch6l9dqnanud32829c8_rp22sh2s8i66or2cljm9p70s3h2bs)
---
[**Sign The Petition**](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zimj3d7l5dqpt8s9o33cdpgpn0aipbjbaivl6vt0_rp22sh2s8i66or2cljm9p70s3h2bs)
---
Our nation is spiraling out of control. Debt threatens to cripple our economy. Federal spending has never been higher -- nor has our deficit. And the politicians in Washington won't do anything to save us. _In fact, most of them are part of the problem!_ A Convention of States is our only hope. You see, our Founding Fathers were brilliant men. They left an emergency clause in the Constitution in case the federal government got too big and out-of-control. **Article V of the Constitution allows the states to bypass Congress and the President to call a Convention of States to propose amendments to our Constitution that will rein in the federal government.** Well, conservative leaders all across the country -- along with over **_FIVE MILLION_** grassroots patriots -- believe it is time to invoke Article V and call a Convention of States for the express, _limited_ purpose of imposing fiscal restraints and term limits on Congress and limiting the power, scope, and jurisdiction of the federal government. And I hope you do, too. With the socialists in control in Washington, it's time to take action before it's too late! It's time for "We the People" to use the most powerful weapon in our arsenal - the Constitution - to fight back against Washington's overreach. [**Please sign the National Petition for an Article V Convention of States right now, and please ask everyone you know to do the same.**](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z95phakoathn5506vqpdulu2acs436e5l2ml7t18_rp22sh2s8i66or2cljm9p70s3h2bs) Here at Convention of States Action, we are working overtime to convince the required 34 state legislatures to call for an Article V convention to place limits on the power and jurisdiction of the federal government. **We have already passed the COS Resolution through the state legislatures in 19 states, including four since the start of this year alone -- bringing us over __HALFWAY__ to calling a Convention of States and taking the power back from the "ruling class" in Washington!** This year alone, the Resolution has passed out of committee in Massachusetts, Pennsylvania, Iowa, and Kansas -- paving the way for the next round of states to pass! With dozens of states currently considering the COS Resolution, _NOW_ is our window of opportunity to double down and secure the needed victories to cross the finish line! We have a citizen activist army operating in all 50 states, working tirelessly to urge their state legislators to act in accordance with the will of the people and demand that they pass this critically important Resolution. **A Convention of States is our only chance to pass important and long overdue measures like a balanced budget amendment, term limits on Congress and the D.C. Swamp, and limits on the scope and jurisdiction of the federal government.** The politicians in Washington wouldn't dare limit their own power. Therefore, we the people need to do it! But in order for that to happen, we need millions and millions of patriotic Americans like you to sign this important national petition. We need to show the members of the state legislatures that the American people are ready for a constitutional solution as big as our nation's problems, an Article V Convention of States. [**Simply click here to sign and we 'll deliver it directly to your state legislators, free of charge. This is our best chance to save America from an out-of-control federal government.**](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z86b4mr5j2k7t5o2lmu94c9qmuuecguv85skm8g0_rp22sh2s8i66or2cljm9p70s3h2bs) Washington won't fix itself. The federal government is too big, and the politicians are too invested in its growth. We the people must take control through our state legislatures. [**Please join the fight to call a Convention of States. Sign the petition today, and urge every freedom-loving American to do the same.**](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zuujps8t7ejjl5al0gsooveqnd981v0e45msm868_rp22sh2s8i66or2cljm9p70s3h2bs)

Peter:
Missouri's conservative State Attorney General, **Eric Schmitt** (R-MO), has won the Republican nomination for U.S. Senate. And unlike the Republican leadership in the Senate, we are working harder than ever to win a _**conservative**_ majority this year!
Eric Schmitt ran in a crowded field of candidates and won a come-from-behind victory in a critical battleground state that will determine control of the Senate.
Now, he faces liberal Anheuser-Busch heiress **Trudy Busch Valentine** (D-MO) in the November election. Valentine has a fortune to spend in this race, and you can be sure the Left's entire political machine will be working day and night to defeat Eric Schmitt.
**[Please support Eric Schmitt's grassroots campaign today!](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61216353:6N9JWwVN4:m:1:3253819041:895CB0179C05DFF14A141988CC65CC62:r)**
_Individuals can give up to $2,900 to Schmitt's general election campaign, but any amount will help, no matter how small._
**The only way for him to compete financially is for us to use the strength of our numbers and bundle thousands of small-dollar donations together for him.**
**[So please take action right now and support one of the strongest conservative Senate candidates in the nation.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61216353:6N9JWwVN4:m:1:3253819041:895CB0179C05DFF14A141988CC65CC62:r)**
Eric Schmitt is a tough, principled constitutional conservative who has fought for the rights of individuals against anti-American, anti-family elites colluding against them. During his tenure as Missouri's Attorney General, Schmitt has been everywhere.
✓ When Democrats manipulated 2020 election rules, Schmitt leaped into the fray, leading other state attorneys general to support election integrity lawsuits in Pennsylvania and Texas.
✓ When school boards tried to force students to wear masks against their parents' objections, Schmitt took them to court on behalf of kids, families, and true science.
✓ When Big Tech firms colluded to cancel conservatives from their platforms, Schmitt launched one of the nation's most extensive investigations into their discriminatory business practices.
✓ When woke activists attacked a Missouri high school football coach for leading his players in prayer before a game, Schmitt defended the coach and made clear to school officials that he did nothing wrong under the law or the Constitution.
✓ Schmitt was also the first Attorney General to sue the Chinese Community Party and the Wuhan Institute of Virology for their criminal negligence, coverups, and lies stemming from the origins of the Covid-19 pandemic.
These were all fights of choice by Eric Schmitt. He didn't have to wage them, and there were plenty of reasons not to. Big donors and the media don't like culture warriors, don't like holding leftists accountable.

**But Eric Schmitt doesn 't work for them - he works for the people. As Attorney General, he put Missouri families first. And in the Senate, he will put America First.**
**[Please help send Eric Schmitt to the U.S. Senate.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61216353:6N9JWwVN4:m:1:3253819041:895CB0179C05DFF14A141988CC65CC62:r)**
The most important job for senators in 2023 won't be passing bills - not with Joe Biden in the White House for two more years. No, it will be investigations - subpoenaing documents, deposing witnesses, finding whistleblowers, and holding hearings. And we need a fighter like Eric Schmitt to do it.
For all Biden's scandals, there's much we still don't know about:
▶︎ Hunter Biden's shady business dealings.
▶︎ The border crisis and the location of illegal immigrants.
▶︎ Anthony Fauci's role in the development of Covid-19.
▶︎ The FBI's targeting of parents as "domestic terrorists."
▶︎ White House collusion with Big Tech on censoring conservatives.
No one will pursue the truth more doggedly than Eric Schmitt. He will join Ted Cruz, Mike Lee, Rand Paul, Ron Johnson, and others in uncovering the facts about how Joe Biden, the Democrats, and the media are trying to steal our freedom and destroy everything that made America great.
Join SCF in supporting Schmitt in Missouri's Senate race this year. He is precisely what we need in Washington right now: a fighter, a truth-teller, and a defender of America's Constitution and culture.
**[Please contribute $25, $35, $50, or more to Eric Schmitt today!](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61216353:6N9JWwVN4:m:1:3253819041:895CB0179C05DFF14A141988CC65CC62:r)**
_SCF will pay all processing fees and transfer 100% of your contribution to his campaign._
Thank you for being part of our team and for doing so much to help build a conservative Senate. Sincerely,

subject: Time to act
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Joy Fox for Congress
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/95767/images/JF%20email%20banner.png]
Hi Peter,
For the second time this month we saw extreme flooding on our state’s roads and highways, leading to stranded drivers, crumbling streets, and collapsed buildings. As we experience more frequent extreme weather events due to climate change, we must create more resilient communities.
We hardly think about our infrastructure when it serves us, but when it doesn’t, we realize how critical it is to our daily activities. I worked for Congressman Langevin during Superstorm Sandy in 2012 and recall when the wastewater treatment plant failed in Warwick. Residents were left without running water or the ability to flush toilets for days.
In Congress, my priorities are:
Strengthening our critical infrastructure to withstand climate change and keep our most vulnerable communities safe.
Creating a robust system of public transportation to lessen on our dependence on gas guzzling cars and trucks.
Ensuring our communities can access clean drinking water by investing in our water infrastructure systems and keeping our bodies of water such as Narragansett Bay and the Scituate Reservoir free from pollutants.
Investing in high-speed internet so that all Rhode Islanders can access it for work and school. We also need to invest in protection against cyber attacks.
Please consider donating to my campaign [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/joy-fox-for-congress-1] so we can bring this agenda to Washington, D.C.
Thank you,
Joy

Peter, I wish I was coming to you with better news. **This morning, Kevin McCarthy’s GOP super PAC launched an attack ad against me on TV.**
