| | At the 87th anniversary of the Social Security Act becoming law, President Biden warned that if Republicans win a congressional majority, the program could be “[on the chopping block](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._bWlkPTQ1NzU3JmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/Ey_M7IOsM6-COYRgoB0kHg).” Frightening senior citizens with lies about Republican plans to cut Social Security or Medicare is a standard part of the Democratic election playbook. A Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee ad claiming that seniors will have to pay $12,500 more for health care "because Republicans voted to end Medicare” earned the ignoble distinction of winning the [PolitiFact 2011 Lie of the Year](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.). To paraphrase Franklin Roosevelt, the only thing Biden and his Democrats have to offer is fear itself. Biden bizarrely stated in his Social Security remarks that “me and my Democratic friends on The Hill are trying to protect it and expand it.” By “expand it” Biden referred to legislation that would dramatically increase Social Security benefits even as the 2022 annual [report of the Social Security Board of Trustees](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.-OnRleHQ9QWNjb3JkaW5nJTIwdG8lMjB0aGUlMjAyMDIyJTIwYW5udWFsLHByb2plY3RlZCUyMGluJTIwdGhlaXIlMjAyMDIxJTIwcmVwb3J0LiJ9/YWW3Kr7JKrUvSbj6Lgs-hg) found that Social Security trust fund reserves are expected to start drying up by 2035. The Democrats’ plans would “protect” Social Security much like blowing a larger hole in the Titanic would have protected that ship. The Democrats’ Senior Scare campaign is underway with ads running in congressional districts that include [North Carolina.](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.)

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50372793/365617861/-2113420158?refcode=JP_EM_PT_3MO_20220829_1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyYjFmODFlYy1lZDJlLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=e3yS__VPJz1htezyCfhtw-2yq8b7CQAo1dqmlzmEXyE=&emci=16654883-b923-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=2b1f81ec-ed2e-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&ceid=6108787) | Peter,

As I get out and about throughout the new 19th Congressional District, I often hear that many worry about their children not being able to afford a home in our region. The communities in our congressional district are among the most desired to live in but also the most difficult to afford in the United States. For way too many people and their families, they just can’t afford to live here.

We need more affordable housing so that people don’t just work but can also enjoy living in our communities!

In response to this crisis, I authored and introduced the Housing Access Improvement Act, which will incentivize the construction of new and affordable housing for those who need it the most.

[This would be a huge step toward creating more affordable homes so that those who work here can also live here. Will you show your support for those working families and this important bill by adding your name to our petition right now?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50372794/365617862/439239838?refcode=JP_EM_PT_3MO_20220829_1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyYjFmODFlYy1lZDJlLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=e3yS__VPJz1htezyCfhtw-2yq8b7CQAo1dqmlzmEXyE=&emci=16654883-b923-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=2b1f81ec-ed2e-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&ceid=6108787)

The Housing Improvement Access Act increases the number of project-based vouchers (PBVs) from 20% to 50%, which will encourage developers to construct or renovate more affordable units.

We’ve already seen great success with PBVs in places like Santa Clara and Pasadena. By expanding the use of PBVs, we can reduce homelessness and provide more Californians with a stable, affordable place to call home.

**Those who work and serve here, like teachers, police officers, and firefighters, deserve the opportunity to live here. With your support right now, we can get this bill passed and help working families in our region spend less time in their commute and more time in their communities!**

[Click here to add your name today!](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50372795/365617863/439239838?refcode=JP_EM_PT_3MO_20220829_1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyYjFmODFlYy1lZDJlLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=e3yS__VPJz1htezyCfhtw-2yq8b7CQAo1dqmlzmEXyE=&emci=16654883-b923-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=2b1f81ec-ed2e-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&ceid=6108787)

clean_body: | Peter, As I get out and about throughout the new 19th Congressional District, I often hear that many worry about their children not being able to afford a home in our region. The communities in our congressional district are among the most desired to live in but also the most difficult to afford in the United States. For way too many people and their families, they just can’t afford to live here. We need more affordable housing so that people don’t just work but can also enjoy living in our communities! In response to this crisis, I authored and introduced the Housing Access Improvement Act, which will incentivize the construction of new and affordable housing for those who need it the most. The Housing Improvement Access Act increases the number of project-based vouchers (PBVs) from 20% to 50%, which will encourage developers to construct or renovate more affordable units. We’ve already seen great success with PBVs in places like Santa Clara and Pasadena. By expanding the use of PBVs, we can reduce homelessness and provide more Californians with a stable, affordable place to call home. Those who work and serve here, like teachers, police officers, and firefighters, deserve the opportunity to live here. With your support right now, we can get this bill passed and help working families in our region spend less time in their commute and more time in their communities! Another dangerous and disastrous bill is headed to Newsom's desk: AB 1757.

AB 1757 is a measure that, in the name of protecting the climate, will directly attack our food chain supply.

This bill will heavily regulate farmers on their carbon output, making it incredibly more expensive to run and operate their farms.

I talked about the dangers of this bill on the Senate floor last week.

WATCH HERE (https://www.instagram.com/reel/Ch8rrfjAXIE?utm_medium=email&utm_source=mailchimp&utm_campaign=This bill is dangerous&utm_term=X)

Policies like AB 1757 might look good as a goal, but the reality is this: it will drive up all of our costs in CA.

And when costs go up, farmers go out of business, failing to compete with Oregon, Nevada, or Arizona who pay much less for fuel, taxes, and costs to supply grocery stores.

Here’s what will happen.

Unfortunately, the governor will probably sign this measure and do a victory lap thinking he's saving Californians from dangerous carbon emissions.

But in reality, he's just driven up the cost of living and putting Californians out of business.

So I’ll ask you this: Can you afford another four years of Gavin Newsom?

We must stop harmful bills from becoming law. As governor, I will veto bills like this.

We are now two months away from election day.

We’re doing everything we can to cross the finish line strong in November, but we are coming up short in our fundraising.

Can you pitch in?

Let's finish strong.

Most of us can agree that one good job should be enough to support a family here in Ohio.

We need bold action for working class families to change that – because no one should have to choose between feeding their kids, paying their rent or their mortgage, and refilling their prescriptions.

body:
I'm proud that my faith tradition helps guide my service to Nevada and our country.
| | |
---
Friend,

Want to know how I first got into politics? I was recruited to run for Congress while serving as the president of my synagogue.

Looking back, although it seems a bit unconventional, it's incredibly fitting that leading Nevada’s largest synagogue was my entry point to public service. My Jewish faith and values are at the very core of so much of my work in the Senate today. In fact, my decision to run for public office in the first place was guided by the Jewish principle of Tikkun Olam – which means to leave the world a better place than how we found it.
**Now, as both the third Jewish woman senator in U.S. history and the only former synagogue president in the Senate, I'm proud that my faith tradition helps guide my service to Nevada and our country.**

I firmly believe that if everybody stands firm and does their part to help better this world, we can move mountains to make positive change happen. **As we face everything from growing antisemitism to attacks on abortion rights and threats to tear down our very democracy, there's never been a more crucial time for us to come together, roll up our sleeves, and make a difference.**
**[So if the principle of Tikkun Olam resonates with you – if you're with me in the fight to make real progress for our country – I hope you'll chip in $5 or more today to help me continue this critical work in the Senate.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50374050/365623038/610767770?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1926-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZTFjZjc2ZS1mMTJlLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kxer9UMpc4Df2TLFOxqM51NQ2Ith0Wa-yiWGRUT5wO4=)**

In fact, my decision to run for public office in the first place was guided by the Jewish principle of Tikkun Olam – which means to leave the world a better place than how we found it. Now, as both the third Jewish woman senator in U.S. history and the only former synagogue president in the Senate, I'm proud that my faith tradition helps guide my service to Nevada and our country. I firmly believe that if everybody stands firm and does their part to help better this world, we can move mountains to make positive change happen. As we face everything from growing antisemitism to attacks on abortion rights and threats to tear down our very democracy, there's never been a more crucial time for us to come together, roll up our sleeves, and make a difference. = Whenever we have the opportunity to stand up and make progress for the people we love and for our communities, we should. Thank you so much for helping me do that today. Jacky | | = | This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Hello,
It was Ben Franklin who, when asked what form of government the constitutional convention had produced, said: “A republic, if you can keep it.”
Donald Trump’s election sealed the deal for me to retire after nearly 4 decades in the U.S. Navy. Having been in uniform for every President since Jimmy Carter, I showed my respect for Mr. Trump with my feet. I was done. It was apparent that the next four years would not go well.
Unfortunately, putting himself before his country culminated when Trump and his fellow Republicans planned, cajoled accomplices, then launched a domestic insurrection on the U.S. Capitol. Five lives were lost, and the nation’s innocence, as well. And it ain’t over.
January 6th set a precedent that leadership in a political party will condone political violence. **To this day, GOP members who continue to perpetuate the Big Lie are a direct threat to our democracy.** An opportunity to come clean for my opponent, Senator Chuck Grassley, who voted against Trump’s impeachment and tried to block a bipartisan commission from investigating the attack, still has yet to occur.
The Republican party needs to cull its ranks of the active insurrectionists. Every single person involved in the January 6 attack needs to be held accountable for their actions, including sitting members of Congress who participated in the planning and execution of the insurrection.
**I’m running for the U.S. Senate against Senator Chuck Grassley because I place nation over baseless insurrection. It is a decision not entirely unlike the time of Lincoln. One does not serve the nation in military service to watch idly while it is dismembered by the likes of Donald Trump and his accomplices, to include Chuck Grassley.**

We did it.
We did it: **I'm officially the Democratic nominee in Florida's critical Senate race, and it's all thanks to the overwhelming support of this grassroots team.**

This is a massive step forward in our movement to flip Florida blue, but the road ahead will be the toughest yet – with recent polls showing Marco Rubio and me _tied_ heading into the general election, we can WIN.

[**But in a race this tight, every dollar will make a difference. If you are committed to flipping Florida blue and defending our Senate majority, I'm personally asking you to become one of my first general election donors by rushing $10 now to split between my campaign and Annette Taddeo.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50366365/365592368/1614649985?refcode=em_fr_2022.09.07_b1_vd_all-nd&refcode2=f724feb2-d82e-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTYxNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNzI0ZmViMi1kODJlLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=oBCjhoE2ecHSoSOuuQG5IajrHPAy6yyDW0aGqrYejqA=)

There was nothing easy about getting to this moment, friend. I grew up as a poor, Black girl in the segregated South. But my family's faith and belief in opportunity taught me perseverance. It was my family, particularly my mother's words of "Never tire of doing good, Val," that pushed me to where I am.

There was nothing easy about being a first-generation college graduate, nor was it easy to work my way up the ranks of the Orlando Police Department. For 27 years, I served when it wasn't exactly ordinary to see a woman on the force, let alone a Black woman. But I never tired, and eventually, I became the first woman to lead my department as chief of police.

My road to this moment – to winning Florida's Senate primary – was not easy, and there won't be anything easy about defeating Marco Rubio in November. But I am determined to meet this moment, to win, to never tire of doing good for my community or of doing good for _you._

**I can't win this race alone, though, friend. The real race begins now, so as we enter this final sprint to Election Day, I need you by my side more urgently than ever.**

clean_body: We did it. We did it: I'm officially the Democratic nominee in Florida's critical Senate race, and it's all thanks to the overwhelming support of this grassroots team. This is a massive step forward in our movement to flip Florida blue, but the road ahead will be the toughest yet – with recent polls showing Marco Rubio and me tied heading into the general election, we can WIN. = There was nothing easy about getting to this moment, friend. I grew up as a poor, Black girl in the segregated South. But my family's faith and belief in opportunity taught me perseverance. It was my family, particularly my mother's words of "Never tire of doing good, Val," that pushed me to where I am. There was nothing easy about being a first-generation college graduate, nor was it easy to work my way up the ranks of the Orlando Police Department. For 27 years, I served when it wasn't exactly ordinary to see a woman on the force, let alone a Black woman. But I never tired, and eventually, I became the first woman to lead my department as chief of police. My road to this moment – to winning Florida's Senate primary – was not easy, and there won't be anything easy about defeating Marco Rubio in November. But I am determined to meet this moment, to win, to never tire of doing good for my community or of doing good for you. I can't win this race alone, though, friend. The real race begins now, so as we enter this final sprint to Election Day, I need you by my side more urgently than ever. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | **********=******** ********=******** ********=******** ********=******** ********=******** ********=******** I am so grateful for every bit of your support. I'll cut right to the chase, friends – a 50-50 Senate split just isn't working for the American people.

That's why I'm running to expand our Senate majority and make real progress on everything from reproductive freedom to voting rights. And I'm running to WIN.

With less than 85 days until the election, I'm teaming up with Mandela Barnes, Cheri Beasley, John Fetterman and Tim Ryan – all tough fighters like me who are running to win in battleground races.

Together, they call us the "Flippable Five," because we represent Democrats' best chance to expand our Senate control – but the truth is, we need more resources to counter GOP spending.

That's why I'm respectfully reaching out to ask: Can you please split a $15 donation between Mandela Barnes, Cheri Beasley, John Fetterman, Tim Ryan and me today to flip these crucial Senate seats and expand our majority? That's why CNN included Florida in its list of five flippable red states – and let me tell you, my Democratic colleagues in North Carolina, Ohio, Pennsylvania and Wisconsin are ALL running impressive campaigns that have the power to defeat the GOP.

There's no question we have what it takes to expand Senate control – but the issue is what we're up against: We just found out that the National Republican Senatorial Committee has raised a jaw-dropping $173 million this election cycle to crush our momentum and take back the Senate.

If Democrats are going to expand Senate control, we can't afford to get outspent and outraised by the GOP. We need Democratic supporters to step up immediately, so I'm counting on you to help the Flippable Five raise $500,000 before midnight tonight.

Peter, unlike so many Members of Congress, I wasn’t a rich businessman when I ran for Congress.

**I was a public high school teacher for 20 years.** And I know how hard the job is – _and how important it is._
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50376708/365634224/452722638?amount=3&refcode=MTFC_20220907_EMDF_E1_T0_AC&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDM2MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMmQ2Y2FkYi1mZDJlLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-PvpuQnNTIJ5WEok4EUQ-JJXEZWzIwt3dBdbVU-t7k4=)
**That’s why I’ve been so upset to see that MAGA Republicans are launching a major culture war against our schools.**

They’re targeting racial justice curriculums, banning books, and cutting teacher salaries. They’re taking over school boards and pushing for so-called "school choice,” a dangerous policy that will devastate public schools of their funding.

**Peter, as we fight for our democracy, freedom, and basic rights, we can’t let this threat to our education get brushed under the rug.**

So here’s what I’ve been doing in Congress to fight back:
* Introduced legislation this year to increase teacher pay,
* Supported canceling student debt so that all students can have the opportunity to go to college,
* And I will continue to fight for public schools, students, and teachers.

[**Peter, I’m fighting for America’s core principles – like high-quality public education. But I need your help now to keep up my work in Congress. Will you support my re-election campaign by chipping in $3 now? Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220907&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220907&amount=28]
Team,
I wanted to send you a quick note on the recent Michigan Republican Party Convention, and what it can tell us about the current state of the GOP.
To recap: the convention was held to officially nominate candidates at the top of the ticket. Usually, this is a perfunctory event, but this convention – along with the convention back in April to select the candidates that were just nominated – was a mess of infighting, booing, yelling, and threats.
From a contentious debate over the Lieutenant Governor nominee, just 73 days before the election, to wild applause for extremists like their Attorney General candidate, Matt DePerno, who champions conspiracies about the 2020 election, to alternate slates offered by a break-away group in Macomb County, to reports of physical altercations -- it was a spectacle.
While everything was unfolding, I texted a colleague in attendance:
secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220907&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220907&amount=28]
We need two healthy parties in this country. But unfortunately, the Michigan Republican Party has been in a battle between classic conservatives and those who hold more extremist views for quite some time. And if this recent convention is any indication – it doesn’t look like this fight will be letting up anytime soon.
It’s Republicans who will have to ultimately restore some sanity in their party. We need brave leaders to reclaim that party. In the meantime, what we can do is send the extreme wing a message in November by shellacking them. Nothing motivates change more than being beaten at the polls. That's the short term goal; the long term goal is a more balanced political system. Because our state and our country are better when we have two functioning parties.
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220907&amount=28]
Elissa

Where’s Chellie Pingree? Will she join other Maine elected officials in condemning the California-based Seafood Watch for “red listing” lobsters? | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/thelanderforcongress/wheres-chellie-lobster-version?e=f8a0a76a2b)

* * *
**Ed Thelander Responds to California-based Seafood Watch “Red List” Designation of Iconic Lobster Industry**
---
|
---
| As the Republican nominee for Maine’s 1st Congressional District, I've been asked more times than I can remember: Where’s Chellie Pingree? Will she join other Maine elected officials in condemning the [California-based Seafood Watch for “red listing”](https://thelanderforcongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=035bf0620f01206429344ca39&id=762c979c62&e=f8a0a76a2b) lobsters?

The argument that lobster gear endangers the whales is based on flawed science and no facts. The last recorded entanglement of a right whale in lobster gear in Maine waters occurred in 2004 — nearly two decades ago — [and even then, the whale was released unharmed](https://thelanderforcongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=035bf0620f01206429344ca39&id=a9078c2de7&e=f8a0a76a2b).

What lobstermen keep telling me is that Pingree is the least active member of the Maine congressional delegation when it comes to defending them from overzealous regulations. It’s not that she opposes them outright, she’s just not showing up. Strange for someone who lives on North Haven — an island where lobster-fishing is the way most families make a living.

I have spent a good part of the summer [swimming between lobster boats](https://thelanderforcongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=035bf0620f01206429344ca39&id=6021fbc6a0&e=f8a0a76a2b), talking with the men and women who do the heavy work of fishing for lobsters. I’ve listened to their frustrations and pledged that, if elected, I will fight for them like no one they’ve ever seen.

Hit the donate button now to send a trained, tried, tested and true fighter to represent Maine’s iconic and economically important lobster industry in Congress.

Can you chip in with a donation now?

Thank you!
-Ed

My name's Tiffany Smiley. I'm a mom of three, veteran's wife, and Republican candidate for U.S. Senate in Washington.

I'm running against a 30-year Democrat incumbent to bring **real change** to our country.

I married my high school sweetheart, Scotty, who was permanently blinded by a suicide bomber while serving in Iraq.

From there, I took on the federal government to fight for the rights that Scotty _**earned**_ as an active duty service member, and I _**won**_.

Fighting for Scotty inspired me to **advocate for _all_ veterans**, so I went to D.C. to speak up for those who put their lives on the line for our country.

Now, I need _your_ help to send me to D.C. to advocate for Washingtonians and all Americans who have been hurt by the terrible policies of Joe Biden and my Democrat opponent Patty Murray.

---

Murray has been in office for _**three decades**_ and has done **nothing** to stop the rising crime, homelessness, and drug addiction crisis tearing my beloved home state apart.

I'm running for U.S. Senate because Americans deserve better than the failed leadership they've been stuck with for _years_.

It's time for a _**change**_ in D.C., and I'm the right person for the job.

The latest polls in Washington show that my opponent and I will be _**neck and neck**_ , and I'm getting nervous. We're _finally_ closing in on Murray, but I need your support to cross the finish line.

_**[Can you chip in any amount to help me take the lead to save Washington?](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=5dee5c0a35814360b546790be5de6a0c&_e=xzBtuDABgX8cmYUlReI7nj7-I1UGwfGIAAz5FCe1tRFCNU3PAhBSXKLOrEYd3J4GJ_00l3t_njEr133lk9YJPDDHxsTFkLQQXZs1uU2NBzO7xCmjo5x-SJ3a62M0GiAcWcrCj7Kli2F0hz3APSNsUK2FoAy2BOIbRsSRYPwBZSMsp05usgUGsFa7mYKM6rMKJg6CqGlx82mdiu-TXxaNSfscRv0FYWjYSqIbdDjp4MD7yWTfYjvKocIcX6cdxcr8aVjmNq10R8xNXK-OuMnPay4aZp2vX46sRVisVWSKphieEPB4Hyn3Q4q9-ukBv9qZtFzFKWYfN7pg86J5zUz0qDTdP3NT1GwxmEABPqGy1DNd73BXlFcl76baGDGBjYqwUQ9-izSkaf_VEGSMTmHIPw%3D%3D "Can you chip in any amount to help me take the lead to save Washington? Your support will bring me closer to restoring the American dream from the U.S. Senate.

name: John Fetterman
subject: Sheetz > Wawa
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
| Hey,

I'm gonna talk about growing up in Pennsylvania, but first, I have to ask: [**Can you split $10 between our campaign and Voter Protection Project to help fund our General Election campaign? I 'm *so* grateful for your support (even if you think Wawa > Sheetz).**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/24557?t=6&akid=4381%2E878179%2EezhdBi) 🙄 Ok, now onto the good stuff.

I was born in Reading, Pennsylvania when my parents were just two teenagers starting out on their own. I love my parents, even if Gisele is their favorite.

We started out struggling. My dad was a union grocery worker at ShopRite, working night shifts. The union way of life helped keep our family together while he went to college. Dad ended up graduating, and got a good job as an underwriter.

After we moved, I grew up in suburban south central Pennsylvania. I graduated from Central York High School and went to college in Reading, just like my dad did.

When I left Pennsylvania for grad school, I *never* envisioned myself ending up in public service -- not as Mayor of Braddock for 15 years, and certainly not as Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania. [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/24557?t=7&akid=4381%2E878179%2EezhdBi) But I came back to Pennsylvania because that's where my heart is. **And alongside my amazing wife, Gisele, I have dedicated my life to improving our Commonwealth.**

When Pennsylvania lawmakers pushed outdated, discriminatory policies banning marriage equality, I officiated one of the first gay marriages in Pennsylvania. 🌈

When Braddock was overlooked and counted out, we created jobs and got young people engaged. We created a community center, urban gardens, and a free store run by Gisele. ✊

And when the Pennsylvania GOP sent their flag police to take down my weed + pride flags, I put them back up. **I 'm just gonna keep doing that.** ✅ [**If that 's the kind of never-give-up attitude you want to see in the U.S. Senate, can you split $10 between our campaign and Voter Protection Project today? To be successful, we're gonna need to build a huge campaign across all 67 Counties in Pennsylvania.**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/24557?t=8&akid=4381%2E878179%2EezhdBi) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between John Fetterman and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $5 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/24553?t=9&akid=4381%2E878179%2EezhdBi)
---
[CONTRIBUTE $25 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/24554?t=10&akid=4381%2E878179%2EezhdBi)
[CONTRIBUTE $50 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/24555?t=11&akid=4381%2E878179%2EezhdBi)
[CONTRIBUTE $100 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/24556?t=12&akid=4381%2E878179%2EezhdBi)
[Or a custom donation »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/24557?t=13&akid=4381%2E878179%2EezhdBi)
You may like Wawa more than Sheetz. You may say #FlyEaglesFly while I say #HereWeGo.

But help send me to the U.S. Senate and I'll fight for *all* of youse, just like I've been fighting for Pennsylvania my whole life.

Thanks,

John

John Fetterman

Derek,

Donald Trump lashes out at those who aim to hold him accountable — so
naturally, he singled me out personally at his latest rally in
Pennsylvania. There were the usual schoolyard insults he tossed my way (“a
watermelon head, but no dummy”), but the next part of what he said was
chilling:

“These are bad people. They’re trying to destroy our country. And we can’t let
it go on any longer... The radical Democrats are engaging in a desperate attempt
to keep me from returning to the White House where they know I will clean this
mess up again.”

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=sep2022_abs_em.7fJa3M&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_AC_20220907_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=831%2E5257348%2ENBhJML ][IMG]

Trump didn’t just come after me — he went after “activist attorney
generals,” “local Democrat DAs,” Congressional committees and federal
agencies, like the FBI. Basically, anyone and anything that he believes
stands in the way of his attaining almost absolute power.

Derek, this is not just about Trump’s attacks on me personally —
it’s bigger than that. This is about defending our democracy. And
defeating Trump’s extreme MAGA Republican candidates at the ballot box,
even as we protect the integrity of our elections.

clean_body: | | Vermont is facing a housing crisis, an overdose crisis, a mental health crisis, a climate crisis, a workforce and child care shortage. We need leadership on those issues. ** The current Republican administration is failing us. They have presided over the most overdose deaths in Vermont history. They're taking away rental vouchers that were promised for 18 months from thousands of Vermonters without warning. They aren’t making Vermont a safe haven for abortion. They refuse to take bold climate action and in fact stop progress. Vermonters who lack access to housing can’t afford two more years of a Republican governor. Our planet can’t afford two more years of a Republican governor. Vermont needs change. | Here’s the good news:** we don’t have to allow a Republican governor to serve yet another term. We can do better. We can choose a governor with empathy. We can choose a governor who has been in our shoes. Unlike the current administration, Brenda is in touch with us and our needs. It will boost American manufacturing for wind, solar, and batteries to power electric vehicles and stationary energy storage.

I will work to empower working people and create jobs that pay.

| _Natalie James is a Democrat running for the U.S. Senate in Arkansas.__Natalie has dedicated her life to standing up for people,__ands she 's running to bring that record of service and accountability to Washington. _ _We 're counting on grassroots support to flip this seat and protect our Senate majority._
---
|
---
| Friend-- I've always believed that a vibrant, healthy community requires good-paying jobs and a thriving, secure middle class -- and the foundation for rebuilding America's middle class is laid by making working men and women the keystone of any initiative to turn our nation around. As a business owner, I know that if you listen to workers and treat them right with living wages, good benefits, and safe working conditions, we all benefit. And that's why, as Arkansas's next United States Senator, I will work to empower working people and create jobs that pay. I support policies that:
* Support a $15 federal minimum wage.
* Guarantee collective bargaining rights for all workers, including government employees, domestic workers, and farmworkers.
* Crackdown on the misclassification of gig workers and other workers as independent contractors.
* Establish wage boards in industries with low union membership to deliver immediate wage gains.
* End federal contracts with employers that pay workers less than $15 an hour without benefits, pay executives more than 150 times more than average workers, and hire workers to replace striking workers or outsource jobs.
* Ban at-will employment, which allows businesses to fire employees at any time and for any reason. This would require companies to fire employees for a “just cause.”
* Protect the Right to Organize Act, the Paycheck Fairness Act, and the Healthy Families Act.

Unfortunately, my opponent refuses to pass a law to raise the minimum wage, leaving many families struggling to make ends meet. It's unacceptable. Thanks for being a part of the fight to build a brighter future for Arkansas. Grateful, Natalie

body:
Our fundraising has been lower than we need for a few months now.
#
Peter, my campaign team encouraged me to write to you today because we could really use a boost in our online fundraising.
Here’s the deal: right now, we’re 13.8% behind pace on our quarterly fundraising goal. That’s important (and concerning) for a few reasons.
We need strong fundraising so that I can campaign in full force for Democrats facing GOP extremists in swing districts and progressives running to expand support for Medicare for All in Congress. And my fight to codify abortion rights, raise the minimum wage to at least $15, nix the filibuster, and pass humane immigration reform is fueled by your support, Peter.
[**So we’re setting a quick, 24 hour goal to get us back on track. Can you chip in $3 to help us raise $7,500 in the next 24 hours?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/17131?refcode=em20220907-1594&t=1&akid=1594%2E420207%2EIdiRkP)
**[Contribute](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/17131?refcode=em20220907-1594&t=20&akid=1594%2E420207%2EIdiRkP)**
And I really do rely on your donations, Peter.
The average online donation to my campaign this year is just $29.30. The majority of folks donating in response to emails like this one give $27 or less. So, I really do need folks to step up today so we can hit our goal.
When the quarterly FEC filing deadline comes at the end of this month, it’s also important because our fundraising numbers will go public. Reporters, DC insiders, and our opponents will look at my fundraising numbers as a measure of the strength of the progressive movement. We want them to know that our movement is strong and not letting up one bit.
The numbers are important. The work of holding our majority and pushing for progressive change is important. The next 9 weeks are so important for our country and our democracy — so we need to pick up on our fundraising.
[**Donate right now to help me hit my $7,500 fundraising goal in the next 24 hours. It really will take a wave of support to get on track to fund all of our midterm plans. Please give what you can now!**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/17131?refcode=em20220907-1594&t=21&akid=1594%2E420207%2EIdiRkP)
**[Contribute](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/17131?refcode=em20220907-1594&t=22&akid=1594%2E420207%2EIdiRkP)**
Thank you for being with me in this tough work in a difficult midterm election year.
In solidarity,
Pramila

Friend, I always want to make sure that grassroots folks like you know _exactly_ who I am and what I stand for. So here are a few important things to know about me:
1\. Long before I was the proud senator from Georgia, I grew up with 11 brothers and sisters in public housing in Savannah. Although we were short on money, our family was long on love and faith.
2. I'm not a senator who used to be a pastor, I'm a pastor who's serving in the Senate! As a man of faith, I believe that my impact doesn't stop at the church door – that's where it starts.
3\. Last year, this people-powered movement defied the odds and the _millions_ of dollars in conservative spending to flip Georgia blue. We won by just 2 points in a historic runoff election, and I became the first Black U.S. Senator in the history of Georgia.
**I'm determined to continue my work in the U.S. Senate to make sure every child can achieve their American dream just like I did. But I can't win this battle alone. The GOP is flooding this race with millions as polling shows me ****1 point down. Whether I can fight back and win depends on generous grassroots supporters like you.**

**[That's why I've got to ask: Will you please give $5 or more now to help me win in Georgia and defend the Senate for Democrats? Judicial Watch announced recently that its client David Flynn, who was removed from his position as head football coach after exercising his right as a parent-citizen to raise concerns about critical race theory and Black Lives Matter propaganda in his daughter’s seventh-grade history class, settled his civil rights lawsuit against his former employers at Dedham Public Schools. As part of the settlement, the Superintendent of Dedham Public Schools, Michael Welch, acknowledged “the important and valid issues” raised by Flynn and specific changes in school policies because of Flynn’s complaint, including banning teachers from promoting Black Lives Matter to students online.
[Read More](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60122&L=27982&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvbWEtc2Nob29sLWRpc3RyaWN0LXNldHRsZXMtbGF3c3VpdC8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1jb3JydXB0aW9uK2Nocm9uaWNsZXMmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1CTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=)

Peter,

In other words, despite Oregon Democrats making this district much more Democrat friendly in the redistricting process - **they made it more favorable to Democrats by 9 more points than it was during the 2020 race** - we’re still running neck and neck with my career politician opponent.

[](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=adb10107b3ac497cbcae0ec5e45b9950&_e=l8EpkoH7cAQfOLXdIhYBbxoQ3Q893hvUy27Zmk1ZTrjsqCsqTtpmUZ9hnd0dBAhY7FsKD7n0dkssWY5jC4-jBFh6iHJxiRb93D_6pWbwgztR8MTJCVYd2zWyH_LFQO0YcVHqQicmSjSNvoHIgKqKd0GXw2fUvXHQUF4H6Q5KmZslyaSdV4Wjfwok1pdRY2b_wPwMQgtwQbEPKgdRd6IMOOX9Fv8lU_zNbKjSqfDTfs-WTIor3IkeMM3jfxw3yyMmhMSKAuVl-USmntuLUFOzJi2XoebFW7oMmiy-OiJVGAmdaz9xO2EttagMJci2e3UzhfpkrU_-kH2_K0AHaxLE3fZU2uNqj_OjO96pzt0Yn-aXMtamhrNHUm84KOMr_9LYFdq2_qFFnlPrp0L8n7Zye1Zv2duhlV1FA6AfV6CesLg%3D)

Forecasts can change often, so now is the moment to act. subject: 📊 New poll: A resounding mandate for climate action

body:
Help us spread the news
| [](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4347?t=2&akid=13096%2E53494%2Evn3jYo) Hi friend, My name is Meryem Karad, and I'm Evergreen's State Campaigns Director. As you probably know, much of our work over the last two years has been laser-focused on the federal level. In 2022, Evergreen set out to build a State Program, recognizing the key role state leaders have as effective drivers of climate action and clean energy policy. And with the just-passed Inflation Reduction Act sending billions of dollars to the states for climate action, state-by-state leadership is crucial for implementing our clean energy future and winning even more climate victories for all communities, especially those historically disadvantaged. That means our team is busier than ever—but I wanted to take a moment to share some really exciting news with you. The Inflation Reduction Act isn't just urgent and effective climate policy. It's immensely popular, too—just ask voters in Michigan and Wisconsin. We teamed up with our friends at Data for Progress to do exactly that, and we found that **nearly two-thirds of voters in each of these crucial swing states support the Inflation Reduction Act and want their governors to fight for clean energy investments that deliver energy savings and protect the quality of our air and water.** [_**Now, we need to show our leaders that climate action is in high demand. You can help by sharing the news and tagging @GovWhitmer and @GovEvers on Twitter today—we have a draft tweet ready to go for you!**_](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4347?t=3&akid=13096%2E53494%2Evn3jYo) | [SEND TWEET](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4347?t=4&akid=13096%2E53494%2Evn3jYo)

name: Mandela Barnes (via Democrats.org)
subject: re: defeating Ron Johnson
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Democratic National Committee, **[www
body:
We can mobilize a coalition strong enough to send Ron Johnson packing, elect Democrats up and down the ballot, and fight for working families. | |
---
Derek, I don’t come from a wealthy or well-connected family. But I _do_ come from a proud union family. My mom was a Milwaukee school teacher for 30 years, and my dad worked the 3rd shift at the General Motors plant. Those jobs were my family's ticket to the middle class. My parents spent their days organizing for better wages and advancing workers' rights. Their example showed me the importance of coming together around shared values and fighting for opportunity for everyone -- a lesson I’ve taken to heart as a community organizer, state legislator, and as lieutenant governor of Wisconsin. [1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Next week, the DNC will vote on whether or not to ban billionaire-funded
super PACs from Democratic primaries — super PACs like AIPAC's "United
Democracy Project" that spent over $3 million on attack ads targeting
Justice Democrat Summer Lee. It’s an amount of outside money in a House
primary we’ve never seen before.

Justice Democrats have been pushing for an end to the massive spending of
corporate super PACs and right-wing billionaires in Democratic primaries.
The DNC must follow our lead and vote to end it. [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/113963?refcode=em20220907-25043&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1020&akid=25043%2E1203867%2ENrXeSI ]Can you chip in
$3 to support our push to give progressives a fighting
chance in primaries against the Democratic establishment?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/113963?refcode=em20220907-25043&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=25043%2E1203867%2ENrXeSI ]Contribute

Summer managed to come out on top, but other Justice Democrats like
Jessica Cisneros and Kina Collins could not win after the deluge of
corporate super PAC spending against them.

It should be crystal clear to the DNC: It’s time to end the influence of
big money corporate super PACs in Democratic primaries.

But, the Democratic Party has shown its unwillingness to even speak out
against the overwhelming super PAC attacks on progressives. In fact, party
leaders like Nancy Pelosi have supported corporate incumbents like Henry
Cuellar and Danny Davis who benefited from the corporate super PAC ads
attacking Jessica and Kina.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/113963?refcode=em20220907-25043&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&akid=25043%2E1203867%2ENrXeSI ]While we continue to fight against the big money corporate interests

funded and proud of it. Can you make a grassroots donation today to fuel
our fight to win more primaries and expand the Squad?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/113963?refcode=em20220907-25043&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1023&akid=25043%2E1203867%2ENrXeSI ]Contribute

news about the DNC vote:

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/113963?refcode=em20220907-25043&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1024&akid=25043%2E1203867%2ENrXeSI ]Bernie Sanders tweet reads: 'Billionaires and their Super PACs must
not be able to buy Democratic Party primaries. If Democrats really believe

second. It’s very likely that the DNC may vote to keep allowing millions

because we threaten their power and the political status quo. But we’re

As we enter the homestretch of our campaign, we have an important question we hope you’ll answer:

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=898%2E61531%2EKqNVQO)
Hello,
We’ve got just under 9 weeks until November’s big election, and our top priority is growing this grassroots movement we’ve been building together. So we need to know: are you with us?
It doesn’t matter to us if you’ve been a longtime supporter of Peter or a recent addition to our coalition—we’re not taking anyone's support for granted. And as we enter the homestretch of our campaign, we have an important question we hope you’ll answer:
[**Will you add your name to publicly endorse Peter Welch for the U.S. Senate? It’s important that we show the strength and size of this grassroots movement, especially at this critical juncture in the race.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/signup/em-endorsement?source=em_20220907_p_t_endorsere&t=3&akid=898%2E61531%2EKqNVQO)
[ENDORSE PETER ](https://act.welchforvermont.com/signup/em-endorsement?source=em_20220907_p_t_endorsere&t=7&t=8&akid=898%2E61531%2EKqNVQO)

Fellow Conservative,

**The same Democrat party that just authorized the unprecedented FBI raid of President Trump’s home over “documents” just voted to give the IRS enough of your hard-earned money to hire 87,000 new IRS agents to come after the rest of us.**

**In what world is 87,000 new IRS agents a priority for our country?**

Sure, the Democrats claim they are just trying to squeeze every possible penny they can out of the American people to fund Biden’s dangerous agenda.**But I think there is much, much more to this power grab.**

name: Charles Booker
subject: Why is Rand so scared?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Booker for Kentucky
body:
[1]Charles Booker

Peter,

We’re only nine weeks away from Election Day, but Rand Paul still hasn’t
committed to debating me. Why is he so scared?

Look, I don’t blame Rand Paul for being afraid of a real debate, but the
people of Kentucky deserve to hear from us. I’ll even make it easy for
him: He can name the place. I’ll debate him anywhere, because unlike Rand,
I’m not afraid.

It’s time our people got some answers from Rand. That’s why we’re publicly
calling on Rand to accept our invitation for a public debate — so Kentucky
knows exactly where we both stand.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/signup/debate-petition-september/?source=em20220907-b&t=1006&akid=2452%2E346206%2EgqjSkt ]Peter, will you
sign my petition demanding Rand Paul debate me? With each additional name,
we’ll build the pressure on Rand.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/signup/debate-petition-september/?source=em20220907-b&t=1007&akid=2452%2E346206%2EgqjSkt ][IMG]

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/signup/debate-petition-september/?source=em20220907-b&t=1008&akid=2452%2E346206%2EgqjSkt ]Add your name →

Rand’s cowardice is nothing new,
Peter. It’s part of his pattern
of being an absent Senator for as long as he’s been in office:

* When Kentuckians try to visit Rand Paul’s office in DC, they are
regularly turned away.
* In Kentucky, Rand Paul only has 1 district office.
* In 12 years, he hasn’t introduced a single bill that has passed.
* And now, when he has a serious opponent, he hides from debates —
because he doesn’t want to face the people of Kentucky.

But we’re not going to let him hide anymore. We’re going to debate him —
publicly — and show Kentucky exactly who he is.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/signup/debate-petition-september/?source=em20220907-b&t=1009&akid=2452%2E346206%2EgqjSkt ]So if you agree that Rand shouldn’t be allowed to hide any longer, add
your name to our petition demanding he debate me.

In solidarity,

Charles

body:
Alexandria is the first female politician to be on the cover of GQ & she discussed gender in politics and in the fight for abortion rights.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220907-3367-header&t=1&akid=3367%2E2526796%2EtceaAt)
Alexandria just became the first female politician to be on the cover of GQ.
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14879?refcode=em20220907-3367-P_FND_ANO_HDL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=13&akid=3367%2E2526796%2EtceaAt)
GQ is an influential mens magazine, and Alexandria took the opportunity to call on men to step up in the fight for abortion rights: “For almost every woman that has gotten an abortion, there’s a man who has either been affected or liberated by that abortion too.”
Of course, conservative commentators were quick to critique. But, as Alexandria responded on Instagram, people who label important cultural conversations as ‘performative’ or attention-seeking usually don’t want these conversations to happen in the first place. In fact, performance has historically been an important tool for progress — from acts of civil disobedience to James Baldwin appearing on the Dick Cavett show. Progress happens in culture. In fact, politics often happens in culture first and then expands.
You can read more from Alexandria’s GQ cover story [here](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14878?t=14&akid=3367%2E2526796%2EtceaAt).
Thank you,
Team AOC
